recipes.title: Chicken Katsu Curry
ingredients: 600g Chicken Breast (butterfly chicken breast into 4 pieces weighing 150g raw each - 600g is the total weight of all pieces)
Salt & Pepper Sesame Seeds (optional topping) Cucumber (optional side)
560g cooked jasmine rice (140g rice per meal - amount can be customised to suit your liking)
directions: To a pan on high heat spray light cooking oil spray then add 100g of chopped carrots & 1 diced onion.

Cook for around 5 minutes or until they get some colour then add 3 diced garlic cloves, 10g of ginger, 10g of curry powder, 1/2 Tbsp of turmeric, 1 Tbsp of honey, 1 Tbsp of lime juice & 400ml of chicken broth.
Mix everything together & simmer on medium heat for 10 - 15 minutes or until the vegetables start to soften.
While thats cooking on a place add 1 egg white & on another plate add 80g of breadcrumbs.
Season each butterflied piece of chicken breast (4 pieces total) with salt & pepper.
One by one dip each piece of chicken in the egg white then evenly coat it in the breadcrumb mixture.

Once each piece is coated lightly spray them with light cooking oil spray then air fry at 200 degrees celsius for 14 - 17 minutes OR bake in the oven at 190 degrees celsius for 18 - 22 minutes. (times may vary depending on the air fryer/oven)
Once the curry is ready transfer everything from the pan into a blender cup & blend for 1 - 2 minutes or until smooth.
Once the chicken is cooked cut each piece into thin slices, serve on 140g of cooked jasmine rice & equally divide the curry into 4 portions.

recipes.title: Cheesy Beef Breakfast Burritos
ingredients: 360g Diced Potatoes (60g per burrito - Brand: Carisma Potatoes)
1/2 Tbsp Olive Oil Smoked Paprika, Salt,
Pepper, Garlic & Onion Powder, Parsley Flakes, Chilli Powder, Chives (optional & customisable)
600g Extra Lean Beef Mince (100g per burrito)
30g Low Fat Cheese (per burrito - Brand: Bega 50% Less Fat Grated Cheese)
6 Low CalorieWraps/Tortillas (Brand: Woolworths Soft White Wraps)

Lightly spray a pan on high heat with lightcooking oil spray then add 600g of extra lean beef mince, 30ml of Worcestershire sauce & 1 Tsp of thesame seasonings above.

Mix everything together & once the mince startsto brown add 1/2 diced onion, mix again & cook through.5. Lightly spray a pan on low - medium heat with light cooking oil spray then add 6 whisked eggs.Gently mix the eggs every 1 - 2 minutes staying on low - medium heat, this is the method to make theperfect fluffy eggs. (season with salt AFTER they are cooked)6. Once everything is evenly distribute the beef, potatoes & eggs across all 6 tortillas (so that there is6 equal servings for each burrito)
Add 30g of low fat cheese onto each burrito.

recipes.title: Butter Chicken Burritos
ingredients: 1 Tsp Each Of Smoked Paprika, Garam Masala, Turmeric, Salt & Pepper
100g Low Fat Greek Yoghurt Ingredients (Butter Chicken)
15g Cashew Nut Butter (or regular cashew nuts)
40g Low Fat Greek Yoghurt Ingredients (For The Burritos)
4 Low Calorie Wraps/Tortillas (Brand: Woolworths Soft White Wraps)
280g Cooked White Rice (70g in each burrito) Coriander Evenly Distribute Butter Chicken Into Each Wrap (weigh total amount and divide by 4)
directions: 1.season with 1 Tsp each of smoked paprika, garam In a bowl add 550g of diced chicken breast, masala, turmeric, salt & pepper.2. Add 3 diced garlic cloves, 15g of ginger, 100g of low fat greek yoghurt & mix everything together.3. Set that aside & to a pan on high heat add 20g of light butter, 1/2 sliced onion, 15g of cashew nutbutter, 400g of diced tomatoes & the same seasonings used above.4. recipes.title: Buffalo Chicken Mac & Cheese
ingredients: 2 Tbsp Buffalo Sauce (added to chicken - Brand: Franks) Garlic Powder, Onion Powder, Smoked Paprika,
5 Servings Light Laughing Cow Cheese (or light cream cheese)
25g Cheese Seasoning (Brand Delicious - or cheese powder from mac & cheese packets)50g Buffalo Sauce (used for sauce)
280g Pasta (Brand: Zafarelli Liscio Piccolo - or pasta of choice) Optional Toppings:
25g greek yoghurt mixed with 1 Tbsp ranch seasoning Spring Onions
directions: In a bowl add 400g of raw diced chicken breast then add 2 Tbsp of buffalo sauce & season with garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, salt, pepper & set aside.

In a blender cup add 300g of low fat cottage cheese, 5 servings of light laughing cow cheese, 2g of mustard powder, 25g of cheese seasoning, garlic powder, onion powder, 50g of buffalo sauce & blend until smooth/creamy.
To a pan on high heat spray with light cooking oil spray & cook the chicken for around 8 minutes (4 min each side)
While the chicken is cooking, cook 280g of pasta per instructions on the packet.
Once they are both cooked in a large bowl add the pasta (drained), cooked chicken & pour the blended sauce on top.
Mix the pasta, chicken & sauce until combined.
Drizzle 20g of buffalo sauce on top with 25g of low calorie ranch & spring onions to garnish. Divide into 4 equal portions & enjoy! (toppings are optional)

recipes.title: Chicken Burrito Bowls
ingredients: Ingredients600g Diced Skinless Chicken (Chicken) Breast (raw weight)Juice From 1 Lime
Salt, Onion Powder, GarlicPowder, Cumin, Chilli Powder & Smoked Paprika (140g Low Fat Greek YoghurtSauce)
2 - 4 Tsp Chipotle Sauce(amount is up to you depending on how spicy you want thesauce) (2 Diced TomatoesPico De Gallo)
1 Diced Seedless Jalapeño1 Diced White Onion Coriander/CilantroJuice From 2 Limes
Salt, Pepper & Garlic Powder Per Meal Prep Container (4Total)
130g Cooked Mexican Style Rice(or your choice of rice - Brand: Continental Mexican Rice)Lettuce Pico De Gallo (evenly distribute)50g Corn
60g Black BeansChicken (around 130g cooked per container)35g Chipotle Sauce
directions: In a bowl add 600g of diced chicken breast & season with 1 Tsp of salt, garlic powder, onion powder, cumin, chilli powder & smoked paprika.
Squeeze the juice from 1/2 a lime & mix everything together.
To make the chipotle sauce mix together 140g of low fat greek yoghurt with 2 - 4 Tsp of chipotle in adobo sauce (amount of sauce is up to you depending how spicy you want it)
To make the easy pico de gallo in a seperate bowl mix together 2 diced tomatoes, 1 diced jalapeño, 1 diced onion, coriander, the juice from 2 limes, salt, garlic powder & pepper.
Spray a pan with light cooking oil & cook the chicken on high heat for 4 minutes on each side.

Line up 4 meal prep containers & in the first one add 130g of pre cooked Mexican rice, lettuce, equal parts of the Pico De Gallo, 50g of corn, 60g of drained black beans, 130g of the chicken & 35g of the sauce.
Repeat the process in the other 3 meal prep containers ensuring all ingredients are distributed equally & enjoy!

recipes.title: Butter Chicken Pasta
ingredients: 100g Low Fat Greek Yoghurt Butter Chicken Sauce:
15g Cashew Nut Butter (optional) or regular cashew nuts
400g Diced/Chopped Tomatoes Same Seasonings Used For Chicken
320g Uncooked Pasta (Brand: Vetta Smart Protein Penne)
directions: In a bowl add 600g of diced chicken breast & season with salt, pepper, 1/2 Tbsp of turmeric, 1 Tbsp of smoked paprika & 1 Tbsp of garam masala.
Add 3 diced garlic cloves, 15g of ginger & 100g of low fat greek yoghurt then mix everything together & set aside.
To a pan on high heat add 20g of light butter, 1/2 sliced onion, 15g of cashew nut butter, 400g of diced tomatoes & the same seasonings above.
Add 40g of low fat greek yoghurt, mix everything together & cook for around 5 minutes.
Once cooked transfer to a blender cup & blend for 1 - 2 minutes or until smooth.
Now it's time to cook the chicken. Spray a pan with light cooking oil spray & cook the chicken on medium heat for 4 - 5 minutes on each side.
While the chicken is cooking you can also start cooking 320g of pasta per instructions on the packet.
Once the chicken is cooked add the blended curry sauce to the chicken on low heat & mix it together.
Drain the pasta, add it to the same pan & keep mixing everything together until well combined. Make sure everything is coated & mixed well.
Top it off with 20ml of light cream & fresh coriander (optional) divide equally into 4 servings & enjoy!

recipes.title: Stuffed Crust Bbq Chicken Pizza
ingredients: 100g Self Raising Flour (Brand Vetta Smart Self Raising Flour - or plain flour mixed with 2g of baking powder)
110g Plain Greek Yoghurt Italian Herb Seasoning, Garlic Powder, Salt BBQ Seasoning (or your choice of seasoning for the chicken)
3 Tbsp BBQ Sauce (Brand: Stubb's - for the pizza base
2 Tbsp BBQ Sauce (Brand: Stubb's - for the topping)
50g Light Cheese (Brand: Bega 50% Less Fat GratedCheese)
25g Sliced Red Onion Parsley Flakes (optional topping)
directions: In a bowl add 100g of self raising flour, 110g of plain greek yoghurt, Italian seasoning, garlic powder & salt.
Mix everything together & using your hands knead it for a few minutes to form a dough.
Season 150g of a thin chicken breast fillet with BBQ seasoning & cook it using a pan on medium heat for around 4 - 5 minutes on each side.
Once the chicken is cooked shred it apart using 2 forks & set aside.
Place the dough on a lightly floured surface then gently & slowly roll the dough out as big as possible (into a circle shape) using a rolling pin.
Cut 3 cheese strings into smaller pieces & place them around the edges of the dough.
Using your hands slowly roll the edge of the dough over the pieces of cheese to form a crust.
Evenly spread 3 Tbsp of BBQ sauce across the base & season with Italian seasoning.
Spread 50g of light cheese across the base followed by the shredded chicken & 25g of sliced red onion.
Bake in the oven at 200 degrees celsius for 22 - 25 minutes.
Once cooked drizzle with 2 Tbsp of BBQ sauce, garnish with parsley, cut & enjoy!

recipes.title: Chilli Chicken Noodles
ingredients: 600g Diced Chicken Breast Smoked Paprika, Salt,
30g Sriracha (use more or less depending on your preferred spice level)
300g Noodles (Brand: Chefs Workout Thin Noodles) Diced Fresh Chilli (optional topping) Spring Onion (optional topping) Sesame Seeds (optional topping)
directions: In a bowl add 600g of diced chicken breast & season well with smoked paprika, pepper & salt.
In a seperate bowl add 25g of cornflour with the same seasonings.
Coat the chicken in the cornflour mixture so that each piece is coated evenly. (i poured all of the cornflour mixture into the bowl of chicken & placed a lid on top then shook it around)
Place the chicken on a baking tray with baking paper, spray each piece with light cooking oil spray & bake in the oven at 180 degrees celsius for 25 - 30 minutes flipping half way.
While the chicken is cooking in a bowl add 40ml of light soy sauce, 100g of light sweet chilli sauce, 30g of sriracha, 20g of honey & mix it together.
Now you can start cooking 300g of thin noodles per instructions on the packet.
To a pan on medium heat add 2 diced garlic cloves, 10g of ginger & 80g of capsicum. Cook for around 5 minutes while mixing.
Once the capsicum starts to slightly soften drain the noodles & add them to the pan along with 1/ of the sauce made in step 5.
Mix everything together then add the chicken to the same pan followed by the rest of the sauce & mix well for 1 - 2 minutes making sure everything is combined.
Equally distribute into 5 servings, top with spring onions, sesame seeds & enjoy!

recipes.title: Loaded Kebab Fries
ingredients: 400g Cut Potatoes (Brand: Coles Baby Carisma Potatoes)
1 Tsp Vinegar Chicken Salt, Pepper, Smoked Paprika (or your choice of seasonings for the fries)
170g Thin Chicken Breast (raw weight) Garlic Powder, Onion Powder, Salt, Pepper & Smoked Paprika (or your choice of seasonings for the chicken)
5g Mined Garlic Squeeze Of Lemon Juice Parsley Flakes (optional)30g Light Mozzarella/Cheese (Brand: Bega 50% Less Fat Grated Cheese)
directions: Start by cutting 400g of potatoes into french fry shapes.
Boil the potatoes on high heat for 3 minutes. (this helps the potatoes stay firm without falling apart when cooking)
Once they are boiled pat them dry & season with chicken salt, pepper & smoked paprika.
Bake in the oven at 220 degrees celsius for 18 - 22 minutes OR air fry at 200 degrees celsius for 18 - 20 minutes.
Season 170g of a thin chicken breast with garlic powder, onion powder, salt, pepper & smoked paprika.
To a pan on high heat spray with light cooking oil spray & cook the chicken on medium heat for 5 minutes on each side.
Once the chicken is cooked shred it apart using 2 forks & set aside.
For the garlic yoghurt sauce in a small bowl mix together 35g of low fat greek yoghurt, 5g of minced garlic, a squeeze of lemon juice & parsley flakes.
Once the fries are ready add them to a plate & layer the chicken on top with 30g of light cheese, 25g of chilli sauce, 20g of BBQ sauce & the garlic yoghurt sauce.

recipes.title: Nandos Chicken & Rice
ingredients: 650g Thin Boneless Skinless Chicken Thigh Oregano, Cumin, Garlic Powder, Smoked Paprika, Turmeric, Salt &
directions: In a bowl add 650g of boneless skinless chicken thighs & season with 1 Tsp each of oregano, cumin, garlic powder, smoked paprika, turmeric, salt & pepper.
Marinate the chicken in 80g of Nandos sauce & mix it together.

Spray a pan with light cooking oil spray & cook the chicken on medium heat for 5 - 7 minutes on each side & once its cooked set it to the side. (time may vary depending on the thickness of the chicken - mine are thin)
To the same pan add 150g of diced capsicum, 1/2 diced onion, 3 diced garlic cloves, 30g of tomato paste & the same seasonings as before.
Add 200g of uncooked basmati rice, mix everything together & pour in 400ml of chicken broth.
Mix again & cook on low - medium heat for around 20 - 25 minutes (gently stir every few minutes)
Cut each piece of chicken into thin slices.
Once the rice is cooked place the chicken on top with parsley, divide into 4 equal servings & enjoy!

recipes.title: Chicken Alfredo
ingredients: 600g Thinly Sliced/Butterflied Chicken Beast (460g cooked) Italian Herb Seasoning, Onion Powder, Garlic Powder, Smoked Paprika, Salt & Pepper
5 Servings Light Laughing Cow Cheese (or light cream cheese)
300g Uncooked Pasta (Brand: Vetta High Fibre Spaghetti)
30g Fresh Grated Parmesan Cheese (or light mozzarella) Fresh Parsley & Parmesan (Optional Toppings)
directions: Start by adding 1 Tsp of olive oil across 600g of butterflied chicken breast.
Using your hands rub the olive oil on each side of the chicken breasts.
Season the chicken on each side with Italian herb seasoning, Onion Powder, Garlic Powder, Smoked Paprika, Salt & Pepper.
Place the chicken on a baking tray with baking paper & bake in the oven at 180 degrees celsius for 25 minutes.
While the chicken is baking in a blender cup add 250ml of skim milk, 5 servings of light laughing cow cheese, Italian herb seasoning, salt & pepper.
Blend for 20 - 30 seconds or until there is no clumps - make sure not to blend it for too long or it will be too runny.
Now cook 300g of pasta per instructions on the packet.
To a pan on high heat pour in the blended sauce & add 30g of parmesan cheese.
Mix everything together & keep stirring until it starts to slightly thicken.
Lower the heat to low - medium then add just under 1/2 cup of pasta water & keep mixing slowly.
Once the pasta is cooked drain it & add it to the pan with the Alfredo sauce.
Stir everything together in the pan until well combined.
To finish it off cut each piece of cooked chicken into thinner slices, lay it on top of the pasta, equally divide it into 4 servings & enjoy!

recipes.title: Creamy Chicken & Rice
ingredients: 600g Raw Chicken Breast (cut chicken breast in half & beaten slightly to flatten so that it cooks evenly & isn't dry) Chipotle Seasoning (or your choice of seasonings such as - paprika, chilli, salt , pepper) Chopped Spinach Fresh Parsley (Sauce)
6 Servings Light Laughing Cow Cheese (or cream cheese - light laughing cow cheese contains more protein)
30g Light Cheddar/Mozzarella (Brand: Bega) Garlic Powder, Parsley Flakes,
2 Tsp Chipotle Sauce (amount is up to you - the more you add the spicier it will be) (Ingredients Per Meal Prep Container - 4 Total)
140g Cooked White Rice Fresh Parsley E l di ib h hi k
directions: In a blender cup add 250ml of skim milk, 6 servings of light laughing cow cheese, 30g of light mozzarella, garlic powder, parsley flakes, salt & pepper.
Add 2 Tsp of chipotle in adobo sauce, blend for 1 minute & set aside.
Season 600g of chicken thinly sliced breast with chipotle seasoning on each side.
Spray a pan with light cooking oil spray & cook the chicken on high heat for around 5 minutes on each side.
Once the chicken is cooked evenly cut each piece into thin slices & set aside.
To the same pan add the blended sauce on low heat with a handful of chopped spinach.
Slowly mix & simmer for 3 - 5 minutes until the sauce is creamy.
Place 140g of cooked white rice in each meal prep container (4 containers) then equally divide the sauce & chicken across each meal. Garnish with fresh parsley & enjoy!

recipes.title: Cheesy Garlic Parm Bread Rolls
ingredients: 250g Self Raising Flour (Brand: Vetta Smart Self Raising Flour - or plain flour mixed with 4 Tsp of baking powder & salt)
65g Light Cheese (Brand: Bega 50% Less Fat Grated Cheese)
directions: In a bowl add 250g of self raising flour, 270g of plain greek yoghurt & garlic powder.
Mix everything together & using your hands knead it for around 5 minutes to form a dough.
Lightly flour a surface & using a rolling pin roll the dough out into a large rectangle shape.
Place 30g of light butter into a bowl & microwave for around 30 seconds or until melted.
Add 3 diced garlic cloves & oregano into the melted butter & mix it together.
Spread half of the melted butter mixture across the dough evenly then sprinkle 65g of light mozzarella & 15g of grated parmesan cheese.
Cut the dough & roll it into 8 pieces (as even as possible)
Bake them in the oven at 180 degrees celsius for 20 - 24 minutes.
Once baked sprinkle a tiny bit of parmesan cheese on each roll (optional) & enjoy!

recipes.title: Protein Pita Bread
ingredients: 128g Self Raising Flour (Brand: Vetta Smart Self Raising Flour - or plain flour mixed with 3 Tsp of baking powder & salt)
directions: In a bowl add 128g of self raising flour, 130g of greek yoghurt & 1 Tbsp of salt.
Mix everything together & using your hands knead it until you have formed a dough.
Weigh the dough & place it on a lightly floured surface.
Equally divide the dough into 6 even balls.
Using a rolling pin roll each ball into a flat circle shape.
This step is optional but if you want to make the circle as perfect as possible you can use a small bowl to place on top of each piece of dough & carefully cut out the edges.

Air fry at 200 degrees celsius for 8 minutes flipping half way OR bake in the oven at 200 degrees celsius for around 10 - 13 minutes flipping half way. Keep an eye on it & make sure to flip once you start seeing the edges brown.
Once they are baked cut around the edges of the middle to create an opening for the pita, fill with your favourite fillings & enjoy!

recipes.title: Chicken Parm Sandwich
ingredients: 500g Chicken Breast (cut chicken breast in half & beat slightly to flatten so that it cooks evenly & isn't dry - 100g cooked per piece) Oregano, Pepper, Salt & Garlic Powder
3 Cheese Corn Thins (or cheese rice cakes)
120g Pizza Sauce (30g per sandwich - Brand: Leggo's Onion, Garlic & Herbs pizza sauce)
directions: Start by seasoning 500g of thinly cut chicken breast with oregano, pepper, salt & garlic powder on each side.
Add 3 cheese corn thins to a blender cup with the same seasonings & 1 Tbsp of smoked paprika.
Blend for 1 minute & pour the mixture onto a plate.
On a seperate plate add 2 egg whites (seperate the yolk from 2 eggs)
One by one dip each piece of chicken in the egg whites & evenly coat each side in the blended corn thin mixture.

Lightly spray each side of the chicken with light cooking oil spray to ensure the crumbing sticks & air fry at 190 degrees celsius for 15 - 20 minutes OR bake in the oven at 200 degrees celsius for 20 - 25 minutes.
Toast each half of the Aldi brioche buns for around 1 minute using a pan on high heat.

Once the chicken is ready its time to start assembling the sandwiches. Place one piece of chicken on the bottom of the toasted Aldi brioche bun followed by 30g of pizza sauce, 20g of fresh mozzarella, parsley flakes & the top bun. Repeat the process for the other 3 sandwiches & enjoy! (I also used a mini blowtorch to melt the mozzarella but this is optional)

recipes.title: High Protein Chicken Gyros
ingredients: 200g Potatoes (Brand: Spud Lite) All Purpose Seasoning (or your choice of seasoning)
130g Diced Chicken Breast (100g cooked) Garlic & Herb Seasoning (or your choice of seasoning)
1 Flatbread/Pita Bread (Brand: Filla Bakery White Lebanese Bread - or the lowest calorie flatbread / pita bread option available near you) Shredded Lettuce
1/2 Sliced Onion Protein Tzatziki Sauce 80g Low Fat Greek Yoghurt (added an extra 20g at the end for visual representation)
directions: Start by cutting 200g of potatoes into french fry shapes & season well with all purpose seasoning.
Spray them with light cooking oil spray & air fry at 180 degrees celsius for 15 - 17 minutes OR bake in the oven at 200 degrees celsius for 22 - 25 minutes.

In a bowl add 80g of low fat greek yoghurt, 10g of garlic, 5g of grated cucumber, a squeeze of lemon juice, 1 Tsp of vinegar, salt, pepper & mix it all together. This is a great low calorie protein tzatziki sauce!
In a bowl add 130g of diced chicken breast & season well with garlic herb seasoning.
Spray a pan with light cooking oil spray & cook the chicken on high heat for 4 minutes on each side.

Grab a low calorie flatbread/ pita bread & spread half of the tzatziki sauce on it then add a handful of shredded lettuce, 50g of diced cucumber, 1/2 diced tomato, 1/2 sliced red onion, the chicken & the rest of the tzatziki sauce.
Finish it off by placing the fries on top, roll the gyro tightly & enjoy!

recipes.title: Jalapeno Popper Chicken Mac & Cheese
ingredients: 5 Servings Light Laughing Cow Cheese (or light/fat free cream cheese)

7 Tbsp Jalapeño Juice (you can add more or less depending how strong you want the flavour - mix after adding each Tbsp & taste test until you are satisfied. You can add diced jalapeños but it will make the sauce green)
25g Cheese Seasoning (or the cheese powder which you get inside store bought mac & cheese packets)
Salt, Pepper, Garlic Powder, Smoked Paprika10g Mustard
280g Pasta (Brand: San Remo Elbows) Thinly Sliced Jalapeños & Chives (optional toppings - can be customised to your own liking)
directions: In a bowl add 300g of low fat cottage cheese, 5 servings of light laughing cow cheese, 7 Tbsp of jalapeño juice, 25g of cheese seasoning, a bit of salt, pepper, garlic powder & 10g of mustard.
Mix everything together & heat it in the microwave for 30 seconds then take it out & mix it again.
Transfer to a blender cup & blend for around 1 minute or until smooth/creamy.
In a seperate bowl add 400g of diced chicken breast & season with salt, pepper, garlic powder & smoked paprika.
Spray a pan with light cooking oil spray & cook the chicken on high heat for around 4 minutes on each side.
While the chicken is cooking you can also start cooking 280g of pasta per instructions on the packet.
Once everything is cooked drain the pasta & add it to a bowl with the chicken, sauce & mix it all together to combine.
Top it off with thinly sliced jalapeños, chives, equally distribute into 4 servings & enjoy!

recipes.title: Chicken Tikka Masala
ingredients: 120g Low Fat Greek Yoghurt (Brand: YoPro Perform Plain)
1 Tsp Salt, Garam Masala, Turmeric, Paprika, Cumin & Coriander Powder Ingredients (Tikka Masala)
40g Low Fat Greek Yoghurt Same Seasonings As Above
directions: In a bowl add 600g of diced chicken breast & add 120g of low fat greek yoghurt, 4 diced garlic cloves, 25g of ginger, 1 Tsp each of salt, garam masala, turmeric, paprika, cumin & coriander powder.
Mix everything together then spray a pan with light cooking oil spray & cook the chicken on high heat for 8 minutes (4 minutes each side)
Set the chicken on a plate to the side & to the same pan add 1/2 diced onion, 450g of canned diced tomatoes, 40g of low fat greek yoghurt & the same seasonings as before.
Mix it together & simmer on medium heat for 2 - 3 minutes.
Transfer the sauce into a blender cup & blend for 30 seconds - 1 minute or until smooth.
Add the blended sauce back to the same pan on low heat with the chicken.
Mix the chicken & sauce together then let it simmer on low heat for 3 minutes.

Each container (4 total) is served with 120g of cooked white rice, 1/4th Tikka Masala & fresh coriander (sides are optional & customisable to your own liking) Evenly distribute the tikka masala into 4 equal portions with your choice of sides & enjoy! *macros above include the rice - naan not included*

recipes.title: Chicken Fajita Pasta
ingredients: 130g Pasta (uncooked weight, I used San Remo Pasta Pro)
100g Sliced Capsicum/Peppers Pasta Water (slowly add small amounts so that you don't add too much resulting in the sauce being too thin & watery)
35g Light Cream Cheese (Brand: Philadelphia) Parsley Flakes (optional)
directions: Start by cooking 130g of pasta per instructions on the packet.
While the pasta is cooking in a bowl add 300g of diced chicken breast & season it with fajita seasoning.
Spray a pan with light cooking oil spray & cook the chicken on high heat.
Just before the chicken is fully cooked add 60g of sliced red onion & 100g of sliced capsicum.
Add a splash of pasta water with 1 Tbsp of fajita seasoning to the vegetables & mix everything together.
Add 3 servings of light laughing cow cheese & keep mixing to combine.
Once the pasta is cooked drain it & add it to the pan with 35g of light cream cheese.
Mix everything together one more time & let it simmer on low - medium heat for 3 - 5 minutes to make it nice & creamy.
Top it off with parsley flakes, evenly distribute into 2 servings & enjoy! Multiply the ingredients x2 if you wish to make 4 servings.

recipes.title: Prep Lasagna
ingredients: 1 Diced Onion Italian Seasoning, Garlic Powder, Parsley Flakes,
30g per sheet Brand: Vetta Smart Lasagna Sheets)
70g Low Fat Cheese / Light Mozzarella (Brand: Bega 50% Less Fat Grated Cheese) (Sauce)
30g Grated Parmesan Cheese Italian Seasoning, Garlic Powder, Salt & Pepper The baking dish I used -
directions: In a blender cup add 400g of low fat cottage cheese, 30g of grated parmesan cheese, Italian seasoning, garlic powder, salt & pepper. Blend for 1 - 2 minutes or until smooth.
Spray a pan with light cooking oil spray & add 1 diced onion on high heat.
Once the onion starts to get some colour add 500g of extra lean beef mince & the same seasonings used above.
Mix everything together & once the mince starts to get some colour add 400g of diced tomatoes with 25g of tomato paste & mix again for another 2 minutes on low heat.
Once its cooked spread 1/2 of the meat evenly onto a baking dish followed by 3 lasagna sheets & add the rest of the meat on top.
Spread 1/2 of the white sauce on the last layer of meat followed by 3 more lasagna sheets, then add the rest of the white sauce on top.
Bake in the oven at 180 degrees celsius for 25 minutes.
Take it out & add 70g of low fat cheese then bake it again for another 5 - 10 minutes.
Evenly distribute the lasagna into 4 equal servings, garnish with parsley flakes & enjoy! (this may require 2 spatulas & some patience)

recipes.title: High Protein Pizza Pasta Bake
ingredients: 375g Pasta (uncooked - Brand: Vetta Smart Protein Spirals)
300g Extra Lean Beef Mince Garlic Salt, Onion Powder, Chilli Powder, Oregano, Parsley Flakes,
90g Light Cheese (Brand: Bega 50% Less Fat Grated Cheese)
directions: Start by cooking 375g of pasta per instructions on the packet.
While the pasta is cooking spray a pan with light cooking oil spray & add 300g of extra lean beef mince on medium heat.
Season with garlic salt, onion powder, chilli powder, mix & let it cook through.
Once the mince starts to get some colour add 1/2 diced red onion & 2 diced garlic cloves.
Keep mixing then add 400g of canned tomato purée.
Season with oregano, parsley flakes, salt, pepper, mix together & add 1/2 cup of pasta water.
Mix one more time then let it simmer on low heat for 3 - 4 minutes.
Once the pasta is cooked drain it, add it to a baking dish with the cooked mince & mix it all together.
Add 90g of light cheese on top with 40g of chorizo salami.
Bake at 180 degrees celsius for 15 minutes.
Top with parsley flakes, divide into 4 equal servings & enjoy!

recipes.title: Creamy Nandos Burrito
ingredients: 4 Low Calorie Wraps/Tortillas (Brand: Woolworths Soft White Wraps)
80g Low Fat Cheese (Brand: Bega 50% Less Fat Grated Cheese)
15g Nandos Peri Peri Sauce (for the chicken marinade)
Salt, Pepper, Smoked Paprika, Garlic Powder, Onion Powder, Oregano
directions: Start by adding 600g of diced chicken thigh into abowl.
Add 15g of peri peri sauce then mix & coat thechicken well.
Season each side of the chicken with salt, pepper,smoked paprika, garlic powder & onion powder.
Air fry at 190 degrees celsius for 16 - 20 minutesOR bake in the oven at 200 degrees celsius for 22 - 25 minutes. (times may vary slightly depending onthe air fryer/oven, keen an eye on it).
While the chicken is cooking, In a blender cupadd 150g of low fat cottage cheese, 50g of peri peri sauce,used above. 10g of honey & a dash of each seasoning

Blend for 1 - 2 minutes or until smooth & creamy.7. Once the chicken is cooked add it into a bowl with the blended sauce.8. Add 80g of low fat cheese & oregano into the bowl then mix everything together to combine.9. Grab 4 low calorie tortillas & one by one evenly distribute the mixture across them all.10. Roll each tortilla up tightly into a burrito, toast for 1 - 2 minutes using a pan on medium heat & enjoy!

recipes.title: Low Calorie Sticky Beef Meal Prep
ingredients: 600g Beef Strips (weighed raw, use lean beef if possible)
2 Tbsp Reduced Salt & Sugar Tomato Sauce
200g Sliced Capsicum/Peppers Meal Prep Per Serve, 4 Total (optional & customisable)
directions: Start by adding 600g of beef strips into a bowl then season with salt & pepper.
In a small bowl mix together 2 Tbsp of reduced sugar tomato sauce, 2 Tbsp of BBQ Sauce, 1 Tbsp of rice wine vinegar, 15g of diced garlic & 1 Tbsp of light soy sauce.
To a pan on high heat add 20ml of sesame oil, once its hot add 600g of beef strips & let it cook through for around 10 minutes.

Once cooked set the beef on a plate to the side & on the same pan add 80g of diced onions, 200g of sliced capsicum & the sauce. 5, Mix everything together then add the cooked beef strips back to the pan & mix it again.
Simmer on low - medium heat for 3 - 5 minutes or until sticky.
Line up 4 meal prep containers & in each one add 125g of cooked white rice, evenly distribute the sticky beef, 15g of spring onions, 1 Tsp of sesame seeds & enjoy!

recipes.title: High Protein Big Mac Quesadilla!
ingredients: 130g Extra Lean Beef Mince Tbsp Onion Powder Garlic Powder
1 Low Calorie Wrap/Tortilla (Brand: Coles 70% Lower Carb Wraps) Sliced Pickles (Optional - can be substituted for jalapeños or relish too)
40g Low Fat Cheese (Brand: Bega 50% Less Fat Grated Cheese)
70g Low Fat Greek Yoghurt (Brand: YoPro Perform Plain)
directions: In a bowl add 25g of tomato sauce/ketchup, 15g of mustard, 1/2 tsp of white wine vinegar, 1 Tbsp of pickle juice, 1/2 Tbsp of onion powder, garlic powder & smoked paprika then mix everything together and set aside.
Using a pan with the stove on high heat lightly spray with cooking oil spray & add 130g of extra lean beef mince.

Start breaking the mince apart & cooking it. Just before its fully cooked through add onion powder, garlic powder, 10g of mustard & 2 Tbsp of Worcestershire sauce. (this stops the meat from being dry)
Grab a low calorie wrap/tortilla & spread half of the sauce from step 1 evenly all over it.
Using only one half of the wrap add the cooked mince, pickles & 40g of low fat cheese.
Fold the other side of the wrap over then toast the quesadilla on high heat for around 1 - 2 minutes using the same pan as before. (or a sandwich press)
Cut the quesadilla & use the other half of the leftover sauce to dip in your quesadilla & enjoy!

recipes.title: Anabolic Crispy Chicken Nuggets
ingredients: 2 Slices ''Country Split'' bread (or any low calorie bread of choice)
300g Less Than 2% Fat Chicken Breast Mince (weighs 270g once cooked in air fryer)
directions: Start by ripping up 2 slices of low calorie bread & placing it into a blender cup with 1 tsp of cayenne pepper.
Blend for 1 minute & pour the blended powder onto a plate.
In a separate bowl add 300g of lean chicken breast mince with 1 small egg, 1 tsp of all in 1 seasoning & 1 tsp of smokey bbq seasoning. (or seasonings of choice)
Mix everything together & once everything is combined one by one form the combined meat into 20 small nugget shapes using your hands (make sure your hands are wet while you are doing this)
Coat each nugget in the blended breadcrumb mixture & bake in the air fryer at 180 degrees celsius for 15 minutes. Once they're done serve with your favourite sauce & enjoy!

recipes.title: Cheesy Jalapeño Popper Quesadilla
ingredients: 60g Low Fat Greek Yoghurt (Brand: YoPro Plain) Garlic Powder, Chilli Powder, & Ranch Seasoning (Brand: Deliciou)
120g Cooked Shredded Chicken or Regular Chicken (Brand: Coles Slow Cooked Shredded Chicken)
1 Low Calorie Wrap/Tortilla (Brand: Simsons Pantry Low Carb High Protein + Fibre Large Wrap)
30g Low Fat Cheese (Brand: Bega 50% Less Fat Grated Cheese)
directions: In a bowl add 20g diced jalapeños, 1 light laughing cow cheese, 60g low fat greek yoghurt & the seasonings mentioned in the ingredient list or your choice of seasoning.
Add 1 Tbsp of jalapeño juice & mix everything together with a spoon.
Once everything is well combined add 120g of cooked shredded chicken or cooked diced chicken breast.
Mix everything together again to combine the sauce & chicken.
Spread the mix evenly across one half of the low calorie wrap/tortilla & add 30g of low fat cheese on top.
Fold the empty side of the wrap/ tortilla over.
Turn the stove on high heat & toast the quesadilla on a pan for a 2-3 minutes on each side.
Once golden brown & toasted cut the quesadilla into 4 pieces & enjoy!

recipes.title: Protein Wrap
ingredients: 18g Plain Flour (Brand: Vetta Smart Protein Plain Flour - any plain flour will work)
80g Egg Whites Garlic Powder (or your choice of seasoning, this is used to hide the taste of the egg whites which is minimal anyway) Cooking Oil Spray (stops the wrap from sticking)
directions: In a blender cup add 18g of plain flour, 80g of egg whites, 1 Tsp of garlic powder & spray the inside with a tiny bit of cooking oil spray.
Blend for 30 seconds.
Turn the stove on medium heat & pour the mixture into a non stick pan. (If you are using a regular pan spray it with non stick spray/cooking oil spray to avoid sticking)
Cook on each side for 2 - 3 minutes (or until lightly brown with brown spots like shown in the picture above)
Once the wrap is cooked cover it in a dry tea towel for 5 - 10 minutes.

Add your favourite fillings & roll it up! This recipe makes 1 large wrap (depending on the size of the pan you use, i suggest using the biggest pan you have available) If you would like to make more at once multiply the ingredients by however many wraps you would like to make, Enjoy!

recipes.title: High Protein Bbq Chicken Quesadilla
ingredients: 200g Egg Whites (or regular eggs, macros will vary)
1 Low Calorie Wrap/Tortilla (Brand: Coles Lower Carb Wraps) BBQ Seasoning (Brand: Masterfoods Seasoning Bbq)
150g Cooked Shredded Chicken (Brand: Coles Slow Cooked Pulled Chicken but you can use cooked chicken breast, chicken mince etc) Parsley Flakes (optional)
20g BBQ Sauce (Brand: Stubb's Original BBQ Sauce)
directions: Start by adding 200g of egg whites to a pan on high heat. Spray the pan with light cooking oil spray beforehand.
Just before the egg whites are cooked (sides of the egg whites are cooked but the top is slightly runny) place a low calorie wrap/tortilla on top.

After about 1 minute flip the wrap over so that the egg whites are now facing upwards & the wrap is on the pan cooking (using a spatula or placing a plate on top & turning the pan over. The video linked at the bottom of this page will show you how i do it)
Add 1 Tbsp of BBQ Seasoning on top & place 150g of cooked shredded chicken on one half of the wrap.
Lower the heat to a low - medium level & add 40g of low fat cheese on top of the chicken.
Using a spatula fold the empty half of the wrap over & press down to let the cheese melt & hold the quesadilla together.
Cook for 1 - 2 minutes on each side or until golden brown & crispy.
Drizzle 20g of BBQ sauce on top (or you can add the BBQ sauce inside the quesadilla after step 5) & enjoy!

recipes.title: Garlic Prawn Pizza
ingredients: 1 Large White Lebanese Bread (Brand: Filla Bakery)
1 Tbsp Garlic Parsley Flakes, Chilli Flakes, Oregano, Salt & Pepper
35g Low Fat Cheese (Brand: Bega 50% Less Fat Grated Cheese)
directions: Start by adding 150g of cooked prawns into a bowl then add 1 Tbsp of garlic followed by a pinch of parsley flakes, chilli flakes, salt, pepper & mix everything together.
Bake 1 large lebanese bread (or large tortilla wrap) in the oven at 180 degrees celsius for 5 minutes. (doing this will ensure the bread is crispy & not floppy)
Once the bread is slightly baked spread 25g of pizza sauce evenly across the base then proceed to add the toppings.
Add a handful of spinach, 150g of prawns, 35g of low fat cheese, & more seasonings if you like.
Bake in the oven again for 8-10 minutes at 180 degrees celsius or until the cheese is melted.
Once you have taken it out the oven drizzle 15g of chilli sauce across the pizza & enjoy!

recipes.title: Meatball Sub
ingredients: 70g Pasta Sauce (Brand: Keep It Cleaner Tomato, Garlic & Basil Pasta Sauce)
130g Less Than 2% Fat Turkey Mince (Brand: Inghams) can be substituted for lean chicken mince, macros will vary.
1 Hot Dog Roll (Brand: Coles Bakery Super Soft Jumbo Hot Dog Rolls) Finely Chopped Spinach (optional)
directions: Start by adding 130g of turkey mince into a bowl with 2 Tbsp of italian seasoning & mix everything together.
Using your hands break apart & shape the mince into balls.

Spray a pan with a bit of light cooking oil spray & cook the turkey mince on high heat. (due to the shape of the turkey balls you will need to roll them every 2 minutes or so to get them nice & brown all over)
Once cooked through add 70g of pasta sauce to the pan, lower the heat to the minimum heat level & mix the turkey mince & pasta sauce together.
Cut open a hot dog roll, place the turkey mince balls inside & add the left over pasta sauce on top.
Add 20g of light cheese on top then bake it in the oven at 200 degrees celsius for 5 minutes or until the cheese melts. (keep the hot dog roll open while it's baking)
Garnish with finely chopped spinach or your choice of vegetables & enjoy! Compared to a regular meatball sub from subway this has more than double the protein & has less calories!

recipes.title: Buffalo Ranch Burger
ingredients: 1 Serving Low Calorie Burger Thin(Brand: Tip Top)
directions: Start by seasoning 170g of chicken breast with 2 tbsp of paprika, 1 tbsp of garlic salt & 1/2 tbsp of pepper (coat the chicken breast on each side using your hands)
Place 20g of panko crumbs on a plate & on a seperate plate/bowl add 25g of egg whites. Once you have done that soak the chicken in the egg whites then coat it in the panko crumbs.
Bake the chicken breast in the air fryer at 180 degrees celsius for 15-20 minutes flipping halfway. (or bake in oven at 200 degrees celsius for around 25 minutes)
Once the chicken is cooked place 50g of Franks Hot Sauce into a bowl & coat the chicken in the hot sauce.
Air fry the chicken breast again for 2 minutes at the same temperature.
Now it's time to build the burger! Place the chicken breast on 1 of the low calorie burger thins, add 20g of ranch dressing then place the last burger thin on top & that's it, enjoy!

recipes.title: Low Calorie Prawn Tacos
ingredients: 130g Prawn/Shrimp Lemon, Herb & Garlic Seasoning (Brand: Masterfoods - or your choice of seasoning) Chilli Fakes Cajun Seasoning Parsley Flakes
4 Street Style Tortillas (Brand: Old El Paso White Corn Tortillas)
directions: Let's start off by making the sauce. In a blender cup add a handful of baby spinach, 100g of low fat greek yoghurt, lime juice (1/2 lime), 1 Tsp of garlic powder & a dash of salt & pepper.
Blend everything together until smooth & set aside.
In a bowl mix together 1/2 diced tomato & 50g of diced capsicum.
Then in a seperate bowl add 130g of prawns & season with lemon herb & garlic seasoning, cajun seasoning & parsley flakes. (or your choice of seasoning)
Mix the prawns & seasoning together then cook them on a non stick pan with the stove on medium heat for 2 - 3 minutes on each side. (if using a regular pan spray with light cooking spray)
Once the prawns are cooked set them to the side, wipe the pan with a paper towel & toast the tortillas on each side.

Add 15g of red cabbage on each tortilla followed by adding the prawns (3 - 4 prawns each tortilla) then spread the diced tomato & capsicum mix evenly across the tacos & finish it off by adding the sauce from step 2 & enjoy!

recipes.title: Greek Chicken Burger
ingredients: 1 Brioche Bun (Brand: Aldi Brioche Bun - only 159 calories)
100g Low Fat Greek Yoghurt (Brand: YoPro Plain)
10g Reduced Fat Fetta Cheese (Brand: South Cape) Oak Lettuce
Salt, Pepper, Smoked Paprika, Garlic Powder & Mint Flakes/Dried Mint
directions: In a bowl mix together 60g of low fat greek yoghurt, 1/2 tsp of salt, pepper, garlic powder & 1 tsp of smoked paprika. (this will be the marinade)
Cut 130g of chicken breast into a thin fillet then place it in the bowl with the yoghurt & marinate/coat the chicken completely.
In a seperate bowl mix together 40g of low fat greek yoghurt with 1/2 Tbsp of lemon juice, 10g of garlic mince & 1 tsp of mint flakes/dried mint. (this will be the sauce)
Spray a bit of cooking oil spray to a pan on high heat & cook the marinated chicken breast.
Once the chicken is cooked toast the bottom of each brioche bun using the same pan for 1 - 2 minutes.

Now it's time to build the burger! Start by adding oak lettuce to the bottom bun followed by 10g of reduced fat fetta cheese, cooked chicken breast, 2 slices of tomato, the yoghurt sauce from step 3 then top it off with the last bun & enjoy!

recipes.title: Protein Turkey Nuggets
ingredients: 300g Less Than 2% Fat Turkey Mince (Brand: Inghams) can be substituted for lean chicken mince, macros will vary.
2 Eggs Garlic Powder, BBQ Seasoning, Smoked Paprika, Salt & Pepper (or your choice of seasonings)
50g Low Fat Cheese (Brand: Bega 50% Less Fat Grated Chees) Light Cooking Oil Spray
directions: In a large bowl add 300g of low fat turkey mince followed by 2 large eggs & 1 Tbsp of garlic powder, BBQ Seasoning, Smoked Paprika, Salt & Pepper.
Add 50g of low fat cheese & mix everything together.
Line a baking tray with baking paper & lightly spray it with light cooking oil spray.
Using your hands form the mince into 20 nuggets. (make sure your hands are wet while doing this, each nugget should weigh around 15g)

Bake in the air fryer at 200 degrees celsius for 10 - 12 minutes flipping half way & enjoy! (if you don't have an air fryer you can bake them in the oven at the same temperature but it will take an extra 5 - 10 minutes. Keep an eye on it and you will know once they are ready when the nuggets start to get golden brown like shown above - oven baking won't make them as crispy as an air fryer will.

recipes.title: Chicken Alfredo Pizza
ingredients: 1 White Lebanese Bread/Flatbread (Brand: Filla Bakery White Lebanese Bread - or pita bread)
60g Alfredo Sauce (Brand: Leggo's - or any store bought/home made alfredo sauce) Onion Powder, Garlic Powder, Parsley Flakes, Italian Seasoning (or your choice of seasoning) Fresh Basil
100g Cooked Chicken Breast (I used pre cooked chicken breast seasoned with all purpose seasoning)40g Low Fat Cheese (Brand: Bega 50% Less Fat Grated Cheese)
directions: Start by blending 70g of low fat cottage cheese using a stick blender or food processor (i personally blend the cottage cheese while its still in the container using a stick blender)
Once blended into a smooth & creamy consistency add the cottage cheese into a bowl with 1 tsp of onion powder, garlic powder, parsley flakes & 60g of alfredo sauce.
Mix everything together until combines & set aside for now.
Grab a white Lebanese bread (or your choice of pizza base) & bake it in the oven at 180 degrees celsius for 4 - 5 minutes (this will ensure the base is crispy & not floppy)

Take the base out the oven once its slightly browned/crispy then spread 80% of the sauce evenly across the base (make sure to save around 20% of the sauce as you will be using that to drizzle on top of the pizza at the end)
Add 100g of cooked chicken breast, 40g of low fat cheese & a handful of fresh basil on top.
Bake in the oven again at 180 degrees celsius for 5 minutes (or until the cheese melts)
Drizzle the left over sauce at the very end & enjoy!

recipes.title: Buffalo Chicken Quesadilla
ingredients: 1 Low Calorie Wrap/Tortilla (Brand: Simsons Pantry Low Carb Garlic Protein Wrap)
120g Cooked Shredded Chicken (Brand: Coles Slow Cooked Pulled Chicken - or cooked chicken breast) All In 1 Seasoning (or seasoning of choice)
25g Low Fat Cheese (Brand: Bega 50% Less Fat Grated Cheese)
directions: In a bowl add 120g of cooked shredded chicken, all in 1 seasoning, 2 tbsp of buffalo sauce & mix it together.
Using a hand mixer blend 60g of low fat cottage cheese & this will turn it into a thick, creamy sauce.
In a small bowl add the blended low fat cottage cheese with 1 Tbsp of ranch seasoning & mix it together.
Place the chicken on one half of the low calorie wrap with 25g of low fat cheese & drizzle the blended low fat cottage cheese/buffalo sauce on top.
Fold the empty side of the wrap over & toast it using a pan with the stove on high heat for 2 minutes & enjoy!

recipes.title: Tuna Melt
ingredients: 1 Can Spring water Tuna (drained) Chilli Flakes & All In 1 Seasoning (or your choice of seasonings)
10g Light Mayonnaise (Brand: Praise 25% Less Sugar Mayo)
1 Egg & 80g Egg Whites (or just regular eggs)
2 Slices Low Calorie Bread (Brand: Country Split)
1 Slice Low Fat Cheese (Brand: Bega So Light)
directions: Add a can of drained tuna into a bowl then add 1/2 Tsp of chilli flakes, 1 Tsp of All In 1 Seasoning, 1/2 Tbsp of lemon juice, 10g of mustard, 10g of light mayonnaise, 1 Tbsp of pickle juice, 20g spring onion, 20g of diced capsicum & mix it together with a spoon.
In a small seperate bowl mix together 1 egg & 80g of egg whites then cook it using a on stick pan on medium heat. (if you are using a regular pan spray with light cooking spray)
Just before the eggs are fully cooked place 2 slices of low calorie bread on top, let it sit for 1 minute then flip it over using a big spatula.
Sprinkle a bit more All In 1 Seasoning on top then add 1 slice of low fat cheese & the tuna mix. (place everything on one half)

Fold the sides of the eggs inwards to the middle, once both sides of the eggs are folded gently hold it down with your hand & using your other hand flip the other side of the bread over to create a sandwich. (this part may be a bit tricky)
Lower the heat & cook for 1 - 2 minutes on each side or until the bread is crispy & enjoy!

recipes.title: Creamy Buffalo Chicken Pasta
ingredients: 130g Protein Pasta (Brand: San Remo Pasta Pro) All Purpose Seasoning & Smoked Paprika (or your choice of seasoning)
50g Buffalo Sauce (Brand: Franks Redhot Buffalo Sauce)
directions: Start by cooking 130g of pasta as per instructions on the package.
While the pasta is cooking add 300g of diced chicken breast to a pan on high heat (lightly spray with cooking oil beforehand if you are not using a non stick pan)
Season the chicken breast with all purpose seasoning & smoked paprika.
Let the chicken cook through then lower the heat from high - medium.
Add 6 servings of light laughing cow cheese, 35g of light cream cheese & 30g of buffalo sauce.
Mix everything together until there is no clumps.
Add the cooked pasta & mix everything together again.
Add 20g of buffalo sauce again & 1/2 cup of pasta water.
Mix it together one more time & let it simmer on low heat for 2 - 3 minutes to make it nice & creamy. (add more pasta water if needed & mix)
Equally distribute into 2 servings & sprinkle with fresh parsley on top, Enjoy!

recipes.title: Bagels
ingredients: 130g Low Fat Greek Yoghurt (Brand: YoPro Plain)
190g Self Raising Flour (Brand: Vetta Smart Protein Self Raising Flour - any regular self raising flour will work)
1 Egg White Bagel Seasoning (Brand:Mingle Bagel Seasoning - optional)
directions: In a bowl add 130g of low fat greek yoghurt & 190g of self raising flour. Mix well until fully combined until a ball of dough remains.
Place the dough ball on a lightly floured surface & knead the dough using your hands for 2 - 3 minutes.
Cut the dough ball into 4 even pieces.
Using your hands roll each piece one by one into a thin rope shape & join both ends of the dough to form a bagel.(about the same thickness as regular store bought bagels)
Place each piece on a baking tray with baking paper.
Seperate 1 egg yolk from the egg white & place the egg white in a small bowl, dip a pastry brush in the egg white & coat each piece of the dough on top lightly.
Lightly sprinkle bagel seasoning on top of each piece of dough.
Bake in the oven at 180 degrees celsius for 20 - 25 minutes. Once cooked you can cut the bagel in half, add your favourite fillings & enjoy!

recipes.title: Low Calorie Sticky Bbq Chicken Strips
ingredients: 20g Stubb's BBQ Sauce (or any low calorie BBQ sauce)
directions: Start by cutting 180g of raw chicken breast into even strips like shown in the photo above.
Place the cut up chicken breast in a bowl & season with salt & pepper.
Add 20g of mustard into the bowl of chicken strips mix everything together. Make sure each piece of chicken is coated.
On a seperate plate add 30g of crushed corn flakes, one by one coat each piece of chicken into the crushed corn flakes.
Once each piece is marinated & coated bake in the air fryer at 180 degrees celsius for 15 minutes. (or oven at 200 degrees celsius for around 20 minutes)
While the chicken is cooking in a bowl add 50g of franks hot buffalo sauce with 20g of stubb's bbq sauce & mix that together.
Once the chicken is cooked soak each piece into sauce mixture one by one then place it back in the air fryer to bake for another 2-3 minutes & enjoy!

recipes.title: Teriyaki Chicken Stir Fry
ingredients: 80g Cooked White/Brown Rice (i used Sunrise Basmati quick rice)
directions: Start by cutting 130g of raw chicken breast into small cubes.
Add 1 tsp of olive oil to a pan on high heat & cook the chicken breast. (7-10 minutes)
While the chicken is cooking slice 60g of capsicum into long thin pieces & cut 30g of green beans in half.
Once the chicken is cooked add salt, pepper & the vegetables to the pan & mix everything together.
Add 30g of teriyaki sauce & 30g of light soy sauce to the pan, mix everything together again & let it cook for another 5 minutes on medium heat.
After 5 minutes add 80g of cooked rice & 150 of cooked cauliflower rice to the pan & mix everything together to combine.
Add your choice of toppings (optional) such as sesame seeds or more vegetables & that's it, enjoy!

recipes.title: Prep Pasta Bake
ingredients: 1 Slice Low Calorie Bread [blended into crumbs] (Brand: Simsons Pantry)
250g Protein Pasta (Brand: San Remo Pasta Pro) Cherry Tomato, Mushroom, Spinach, Capsicum & Spring Onion (or your choice of vegetables)
directions: In a bowl add 500g of extra lean beef mince with 1 egg, 1 blended slice of bread, salt, pepper, chilli flakes & 1 tbsp of minced garlic.
Mix everything together & using your hands form the meat into small even balls.
Cook the meatballs on a pan on medium heat (non stick or normal pan with a drop of olive oil if needed)
Cook 250g of protein pasta while the meatballs are cooking. (cook the pasta using the instructions on the box)
Once the meatballs are cooked set them to the side in a bowl & chop up your choice of vegetables & amount that you desire, more vegetables = more volume!
Once the vegetables are chopped add them to the same pan you used to cook the meatballs & add 200g of tomato passata with a dash of salt, pepper & oregano.
Drain around 80% of the pasta water into the pan with the vegetables & mix it together.
Once everything is mixed together pour it all into a big baking dish & bake in the oven at 200 degrees celsius for 25 minutes.
Once baked take it out the oven & crumble 35g of fetta cheese across the pasta dish then place it back in the oven for 5 minutes & enjoy! Split into 4 servings perfect for meal prep.

recipes.title: Creamy Pesto Chicken Pasta
ingredients: Pepper, Garlic Salt & Italian Seasoning (Brand: Masterfoods)
directions: Start by cooking 120g of spaghetti (8 - 10 minutes) & while that's cooking in a small bowl season 240g of diced chicken breast with pepper, garlic salt, Italian seasoning & mix it together.
Lightly spray a pan with light cooking oil spray, turn the stove on high heat & add 60g of diced red onion, 20g of minced garlic & 240g of the diced & seasoned chicken breast.
Once the chicken is nearly cooked through turn the stove down to medium heat & add 80ml of light thickened cream, 47g of basil pesto, 1 Tbsp of lemon juice & stir everything together.
Turn the stove down to low heat, add the spaghetti (drained) to the pan with 1/2 cup of pasta water & stir once more.
Let it simmer on low heat for 2 - 3 minutes, equally distribute into 2 servings & sprinkle 10g of parmesan on each serving with some parsley & enjoy!

recipes.title: High Protein Breakfast Sandwich
ingredients: 2 Slices Low Calorie Bread (Brand: Country Split)
50g Slow Cooked Pulled Chicken (Brand: Coles) Spinach
30g Light Cheese (Brand: Bega 50% Less Fat Grated Cheese) All Purpose Seasoning
directions: Start by adding 2 eggs into a bowl & whisking with a fork.
Spray a pan with light cooking oil spray & pour the eggs in on medium heat.
While the eggs are still slightly runny add 2 slices of bread opposite each other.
After 1 minute flip the eggs & bread over.
Add 4 slices of tomato, 50g of slow cooked chicken, a handful of spinach & 30g of light mozzarella to only one side of the piece of bread.
Season with all purpose seasoning then fold the sides of the eggs inwards & flip one side of the bread over to create a sandwich.
Cook for another 30 seconds on each side to make sure the bread is toasted well & enjoy!

recipes.title: Cheesy Protein Bread Rolls
ingredients: 100ml Unsweetened Almond Milk (or milk of choice)
190g Self Raising Flour (Brand: Vetta Protein Self Raising Flour)
directions: In a bowl add 100ml of unsweetened almond milk, 190g of self raising flour, 60g of low fat grated cheese, 100g of low fat greek yoghurt & 1 tbsp of oregano.
Mix everything together until a thick dough ball is formed.
Using your hands roll the dough into 4 smaller separate even balls & place them on a baking tray with baking paper.
Season each ball with 1/2 tsp of garlic salt & oregano then place in the oven & bake at 180 degrees celsius for 15 minutes & enjoy! (or until golden brown & crispy on the top)

recipes.title: Chilli Garlic Prawn Bowl
ingredients: 70g Cooked Uncle Ben's Tex-mex Style Brown Rice Quinoa & Beans (or rice of choice)
directions: Start by seasoning 200g of prawns with salt, paprika & parsley flakes.
Once the prawns are seasoned add 1/2 tsp of olive oil to a pan & cook the prawns on medium heat.
Place the prawns to the side on a plate once they are cooked & using the same pan add 80g of nandos garlic peri peri sauce with 5g of diced garlic. Simmer for 1-2 minutes & gently mix.
Add the prawns back into the pan with the sauce & mix together for another minute or two then place the prawns to the side again once marinated.

Using the same pan that the prawns were cooked in now add 200g of cooked cauliflower rice & 70g of cooked white/brown rice. Mix together for 1-2 minutes so that the leftover sauce from the prawns soaks into the rice mixture. (cook rice & cauliflower rice as per instructions on packaging, i used the microwave for both)

Now place the rice mix in a bowl & add the prawns on top with 20g of spring onion 5g of chopped chilli. This recipe can be made in larger batches for meal prep & customised to your own liking with different sauces & vegetables! Enjoy.

recipes.title: Greek Turkey Burger
ingredients: 1 Tbsp Diced Onion Smoked Paprika BBQ Seasoning or seasoning of choice (Brand: Bronte Blends)
25g Greek Yoghurt (Brand: YoPro Plain) Grated Cucumber Lemon Juice Dill
directions: Start by placing 150g of turkey breast mince into a bowl & mix with 1 tbsp of diced onion, smoked paprika & BBQ seasoning.
Using your hands mix the turkey mince together to combine the ingredients, once mixed form the turkey mince into a ball.
Using your hand flatten the ball to turn the mince into a patty.

To make the protein tzatziki sauce in a separate bowl mix together 25g of greek yoghurt, a tiny bit of grated cucumber, a drop of lemon juice, dill, salt & pepper. (or seasonings of choice, if you'd like to use store bought tzatziki or a different sauce for convenience you can)
Turn the stove on high heat & cook the turkey patty on a pan for a few minutes on each side or until brown.
Just before the patty is fully cooked place each brioche bun on the pan as well. (optional step, this is to make the bun warm & crispy)
Once the patty is cooked it's time to assemble your burger! Place the patty on the bun followed by the tzatziki sauce, tomato slice, spinach then the last bun & you're done. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Low Calorie Bbq Meat Lovers Pizza
ingredients: 1 Large White Lebanese Bread (Brand: Filla Bakery)
Peppercorn the Good Food Company) Oregano
directions: Start by seasoning 150g of extra lean beef mince with salt & pepper.
Cook the beef mince using a pan on high heat for a few minutes, once cooked put aside.
Using the same pan cook 1 serving (57g) of extra lean beef chipolatas (sausages) once cooked cut the sausages into small pieces put aside with the cooked beef mince.
Bake 1 large lebanese bread (or large tortilla wrap/pizza base) in the oven at 180 degrees celsius for 5 minutes. (doing this will ensure the bread is crispy & not floppy)
Once the bread is slightly baked spread 25g of pizza sauce evenly across the base then proceed to add the toppings.
Start by adding 35g of low fat cheese then add the extra lean beef mince, beef chipolatas (sausages), 40g of sliced chicken & oregano on top.
Bake in the oven again for 5-10 minutes at 180 degrees celsius or until the cheese is melted.
Once you have taken it out the oven drizzle 2 tbsp of Stubb's BBQ sauce (or any low calorie BBQ sauce) across the pizza & enjoy!

recipes.title: Nandos Chicken Pasta
ingredients: 1 Tbsp Nandos Peri Peri Hot Sauce (or any hot sauce) Parsley Flakes, Cajun Seasoning, Oregano, Nandos Peri Peri Seasoning (or seasonings of choice)
directions: Start by cutting 70g of raw chicken breast into small strips & seasoning lightly with paprika & Nandos peri peri seasoning.
Cook the chicken & set it to the side for now.
Cook 80g of protein pasta (as per instructions on the packaging)

While the pasta is cooking in a blender cup add 35g of pasta sauce, 60g of low fat cottage cheese, 1 tbsp of Nandos peri peri hot sauce, parsley flakes, cajun seasoning & oregano. (or your choice of seasonings & amount, i only added a light dash of each seasoning)
Blend it together & set the cup aside for now.
Once the pasta is cooked strain out the pasta water then add the pasta to a bowl with the blended sauce & mix everything together.
Pour the pasta onto a plate & add the cooked chicken breast on top & enjoy!

recipes.title: Potato Chips
ingredients: 25% less carbs than regular potatoes but any potatoes will work)
directions: Start by cutting off the ends of the potatoes & slice them into thin slices (about as thin as paper, i used a mandoline slicer)
Fill a bowl with water (just past half way) & add 2 cups of ice then let the potatoes soak for 1 - 2 minutes. (this will remove the extra starch)
Place the potatoes on a plate with baking paper & sprinkle with salt or your choice of seasonings.

Place them in the microwave for 5 - 6 minutes flipping half way. (everyones microwaves are different so keep an eye on them, flip when you start seeing a golden brown crispy colour on top of the potato slices - this will ensure they are crispy)
Serve on it's own or with any low calorie dipping sauce & enjoy! The entire amount shown above is only 124 calories. Compared to regular potato chips this has 10x less calories!

recipes.title: Cheesy Pizzadilla
ingredients: 200g Egg Whites (Brand: Puregg Simply Egg Whites - I use carton egg whites but you can use regular eggs too)
1 Low Calorie Wrap/Tortilla (Brand: Simsons Pantry Lite Low Carb Wraps)
20g Pizza Sauce (Brand: Leggo's Garlic & Herb Tomato Sauce - or any tomato puree/paste or sauce)
40g Chorizo Salami (Brand: Provedore Mild Chorizo Salami - or turkey
35g Low Fat Cheese (Brand: Bega 50% Less Fat Grated Cheese)Oregano & All Purpose Seasoning (or your choice of seasoning)
directions: Add 200g of egg whites to a pan with the stove on high heat (I used a non stick pan, if you are using a regular pan spray the pan with light cooking oil spray beforehand so that the egg whites do not stick)
Let the egg whites cook for 2 - 3 minutes & just before they are fully cooked (still slightly runny at the top but cooked on the sides) place a low calorie wrap/tortilla on top.

Let it cook for 1 more minute then flip the wrap over so that the egg whites are now facing upwards & the wrap is on the pan cooking (using a spatula or placing a plate on top & turning the pan over. The video linked at the bottom of this page will show you how i do it)
Lower the heat from high to low then spread 20g of pizza sauce on one half of the wrap followed by oregano, all purpose seasoning, 40g of chorizo salami & 35g of low fat cheese.
Using a spatula fold the empty half of the wrap over & press down to let the cheese melt which will hold the quesadilla together.
Flip & cook on the other side for 2 - 3 minutes or until golden brown/crispy & enjoy!

recipes.title: High Protien Kfc Zinger Wrap
ingredients: 4 Tortilla Chips (Brand: Mission Style Tortilla Triangles
directions: Start by seasoning 130g of chicken breast with salt, pepper & paprika on each side.
In a bowl add 25g of franks hot sauce & on a seperate plate add 15g of crushed corn flakes.
Soak the chicken breast in the franks hot sauce then coat it in the crushed corn flakes.
Bake the chicken in the air fryer at 180 degrees celsius for 15-18 minutes (or in the oven at 200 degrees celsius for 25-30 minutes)
In a small bowl mix together 20g of fat free mayonnaise & 2 tsp of sriracha sauce.
Once the chicken is cooked cut it into small strips.
Place 20g of coleslaw along the middle of a low calorie wrap then add the chicken, the sauce & 4 tortilla chips broken into small pieces & that's it! Enjoy.

recipes.title: Bbq Chicken Loaded Fries
ingredients: 150g Cooked Pulled Chicken (Brand: Coles) Garlic & Herb Seasoning (or seasoning of choice)
2 Tbsp Stubb's BBQ Sauce (or any low calorie sauce)
directions: Start by cutting 200g of potatoes into thick french fry shapes, add them to a bowl & season with garlic & herb seasoning. Make sure to mix the potatoes around to coat them completely.
Bake in the air fryer for 10 - 15 minutes at 18- degrees celsius. (or bake in oven at 200 degrees celsius for around 25 minutes)
While the potatoes are baking add 150g of cooked pulled chicken into a bowl with 2 tbsp of BBQ sauce & mix it together.
Once the potatoes are cooked place them in a small oven safe baking dish & add the chicken on top.
Add 35g of low fat cheese in the middle & bake in the oven at 200 degrees celsius for 5 minutes (or until the cheese is melted)
Take it out the oven then add 20g of chopped capsicums, spring onion, parsley, 20g of hot chilli sauce & enjoy!

recipes.title: Butter Chicken Quesadilla
ingredients: 1 Low Calorie Wrap/Tortilla (Brand: Mission Low Gi + Protein Wrap)
120g Cooked Shredded Chicken (Brand: Coles Slow Cooked Pulled Chicken - or regular diced/shredded chicken breast)
60g Low Fat Greek Yoghurt (Brand: YoPro Plain) Cumin, Turmeric, Smoked Paprika & Pepper
10g Butter Chicken Paste (Brand: The Spice Tailor - or any flavoured curry paste)
25g Low Fat Cheese (Brand: Bega 50% Less Fat Grated Cheese)
directions: In a bowl add 60g of low fat greek yoghurt, 10g of butter chicken paste, 1/2 tsp of cumin, turmeric, smoked paprika & pepper.
Mix everything together then add 120g of cooked shredded chicken & mix that together as well.
Place the chicken mixture evenly on one half of the low calorie wrap.
Add 25g of low fat cheese on top & fold the empty side of the wrap over.

Toast the quesadilla using a pan with the stove on high heat for 2 minutes on each side or until golden brown/crispy & enjoy! (can also be toasted in a sandwich press, air fryer or anything you have available)

recipes.title: Nandos Wrap
ingredients: 30g Nandos Peri Peri Garlic Sauce Lettuce (or salad of choice) Parsley Flakes & Smokey BBQ Seasoning (or seasonings of choice)
directions: First we will start off by making the protein sauce. Blend 70g of low fat cottage cheese & add it to a small bowl then season with parsley flakes & bbq seasoning, mix well to combine. (or seasonings of choice)
Add 1 cheese corn thin/rice cake to a blender cup (make sure the blender cup is dry) & blend until it turns into a powder. Once blended pour the powder onto a plate.
On a seperate plate add 20g of egg whites.
Soak 120g of chicken breast in the egg whites then place the chicken breast in the blended corn thin powder & coat the chicken completely.
Bake the chicken breast in the air fryer at 180 degrees celsius for 15 minutes. (or in the oven at 200 degrees celsius for 20-25 min)
Pour 30g of nandos peri peri sauce into a separate bowl & once the chicken is cooked coat it in the nandos sauce.
Bake the chicken again for 2 minutes then take it out & cut it into small strips.
Now it's time to build your wrap! On a low calorie wrap add the salad/lettuce, the chicken & finish it off by drizzling the sauce on top & enjoy!

recipes.title: Baked Potato Nachos
ingredients: 150g Low Fat Cottage Cheese (blended) Garlic Salt & Pepper (or seasonings of choice)
50g Diced Bacon (Brand: Don) Low Calorie Cooking Spray (optional, i used avocado oil) Spring Onion
directions: Start by cutting 300g of potatoes into oval shapes (thick or thin depending on your liking)
Add the cut potatoes into a bowl & season with garlic salt & pepper. Mix everything together to coat the potatoes completely.
Place the potatoes on a baking tray with baking paper & spray the potatoes lightly with cooking spray (cooking spray is optional, this is to make the potatoes crispier)
Bake in the oven at 200 degrees celsius for 10-15 minutes.
Take the potatoes out the oven & flip each one over then place them all together closely like shown in the picture above.
Bake again for 5-10 Minutes
Take the potatoes out the oven & add the blended cottage cheese on top with 50g of diced bacon bits.
Bake in the oven one more time for 5-10 minutes to crisp up the bacon bits & melt the blended cottage cheese slightly.
Take the potatoes out the oven & top with spring onion (optional) & enjoy!

recipes.title: Pesto Chicken Pasta
ingredients: 1/2 Tbsp Olive Oil Garlic Herb Seasoning (Brand: Bronte Blends - optional) Water
directions: Start by cutting 70g of raw chicken breast into small strips & seasoning lightly with garlic herb seasoning (or seasonings of choice)
Cook the chicken & set it to the side for now.
Cook 80g of protein pasta (as per instructions on the packaging)

While the pasta is cooking in a blender cup add 90g of fresh basil, 2 garlic cloves, 8g of roasted pine nuts, 1/2 tsp of lemon juice, 1/2 tbsp of olive oil, 1/2 tbsp garlic herb seasoning (optional) & water (the amount of water you use is up to you & your liking, i used about 1/3 of a cup. The less water you use the thicker the sauce will be & the more you use the thinner it will be)
Blend it together to create the low calorie pesto sauce.
Once the pasta is cooked strain out the pasta water then add the pasta to a bowl with 1/2 of the pesto sauce, 60g of blended low fat cottage cheese & mix it all together.
Pour the pasta onto a plate & add the cooked chicken breast on top & enjoy!

recipes.title: Chicken Bacon Ranch Quesadilla
ingredients: 80g Low Fat Greek Yoghurt (Brand: YoPro Plain)
1 Serving Light Laughing Cow Cheese (optional - makes it creamier) Onion Powder, Garlic Powder, All Purpose Seasoning & Ranch Seasoning (Brand: Deliciou - or your choice of seasonings)
120g Cooked Shredded Chicken (Brand: Coles Slow Cooked Pulled Chicken - or regular cooked & diced chicken breast)
1 Low Calorie Wrap/Tortilla(Brand: Coles 70% Lower Carb Wraps)
25g Low Fat Cheese (Brand: Bega 50% Less Fat Grated Cheese)
directions: In a bowl add 80g of low fat greek yoghurt, 10g of chopped spring onion, 1 serving of light laughing cow cheese, 1 tsp of garlic powder, onion powder, all purpose seasoning, ranch seasoning & mix well to combine.
Add 120g of cooked shredded chicken into the bowl & mix again until the sauce & chicken have combined.
Set that bowl aside for now & to a pan on high heat cook 40g of short cut bacon until crispy (or cook using your preferred method such as an oven/air fryer)
Dice the bacon into small pieces once cooked & set aside.
Grab a low calorie wrap/tortilla & place the chicken mixture evenly on one half of the wrap.
Add 25g of low fat cheese. & the diced bacon bits on top then fold the empty side of the wrap over.
Toast the quesadilla using a pan with the stove on high heat for 2 minutes on each side or until golden brown/crispy & enjoy!

recipes.title: Low Calorie Spicy Chicken Tenders
ingredients: 60g Sweet Baby Rays Buffalo Wing Sauce
directions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees celsius.
Add 300g of chicken tenderloins to a bowl then season with 1 tsp of garlic salt, 1 tsp of paprika, 1 tsp of parsley flakes & 2 Tbsp of chilli flakes.
Mix the chicken tenderloins & seasonings together and put aside for now.
On a seperate plate crush 40g of corn flakes & in another separate bowl add 30g of egg whites.
One by one soak each chicken tenderloin in the egg whites then place it on the plate with crushed corn flakes. Roll the chicken tenderloin around in the crushed corn flakes till covered completely.
Repeat the process with all chicken tenderloins.

recipes.title: Creamy Chicken Alfredo Pasta
ingredients: 130g Chicken Breast (100g cooked - 50g cooked per serving) Garlic & Herb Seasoning (Brand: Masterfoods) Oregano
20g Low Fat Cheese (Brand: Bega 50% Less Fat Grated Cheese)
200g Protein Pasta (100g per serve - Brand: San Remo Pasta Pro) Parsley Flakes (optional)
directions: Start by cooking 200g of protein pasta (as per instructions on the package)

While the pasta is cooking in a blender cup add 200g of low fat cottage cheese, 2 servings of light laughing cow cheese, 80ml of skim milk, oregano & garlic herb seasoning. Blend it together for 1 - 2 minutes until you have a thick creamy sauce & set it aside.
Season 130g of chicken breast with garlic & herb seasoning.
Spray a pan with light cooking oil & cook the chicken on high heat, once cooked set it aside.
Lower the stove heat from high to low & add the blended sauce from step 2 to the pan.
Add 20g of low fat cheese & stir gently for 2 minutes.
Pour in some pasta water into the pan & mix together for 1 minute. (the salty, starchy water not only adds flavour but helps glue the pasta & sauce together, it will also help thicken the sauce)
Add 200g of cooked pasta, stir for 1 minute then let it simmer for 1 more minute.
While its simmering slice the chicken breast into thin long pieces.
Evenly distribute the pasta in half, add it to a plate with half of the chicken breast slices on top & garnish with parsley flakes. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Breakfast Toasted Wrap
ingredients: 1 Low Calorie Wrap/Tortilla (i used the brand Simsons Pantry)
25g Low Fat Cheese (Brand: Bega 50% Less Fat Grated Cheese)
directions: Start by cooking 200g of egg whites on a non stick pan with the stove on high heat. (normal pan can be used but will require non stick spray/oil & calories will vary)
Season egg whites with 1 tsp of chilli flakes, 1 tsp of garlic salt & 1 tsp of pepper.
Once the egg whites are cooked & aren't liquidy place 1 low calorie wrap on top of the egg whites.
Let it cook for another minute then flip the wrap over so that the wrap is on the bottom of the pan.
From here you are only going to be concentrating on adding the rest of the ingredients to ONE half of the wrap as you will be folding it later on.

recipes.title: Breakfast Toasted Wrap
ingredients: 1 Low Calorie Wrap/Tortilla (i used the brand Simsons Pantry)
25g Low Fat Cheese (Brand: Bega 50% Less Fat Grated Cheese)
directions: Add 20g of baby spinach, 50g of honey leg ham, 1/2 chopped tomato & 25g of low fat cheese on one side of the wrap.
Using a wooden spatula fold the empty side of the wrap over & press down with the spatula. Let it cook for 1 minute then flip the wrap over & let the other side cook for 1 minute as well.
Finish off by drizzling 20g of Nandos Perinaise sauce across your wrap & add top with 1/2 tsp of parsley flakes & enjoy! (toppings are optional & customizable)

recipes.title: Xmas Style Pizza
ingredients: 50% Lower Carb High Protein Pizza Base (Woolworths)
35g Sweet Baby Rays Honey Chipotle Sauce
directions: Start by baking the pizza base in the oven on its own at 180 degrees celsius for 5 minutes, this will ensure the pizza is nice & crispy!
Take the pizza base out the oven & spread 35g of Sweet Baby Rays honey chipotle sauce on the pizza base.
Add 10g of rocket, 5 cherry tomatoes, 10g of red capsicum, 10g of onion & season with 1 tsp of oregano & 1 tsp of garlic salt.
Now add 20g of sliced honey leg ham & 30g of low fat cheese.
Bake in the oven at 180 degrees for 10-15 minutes. (check every few minutes to decide when to take the pizza out depending on your desired texture, just make sure it doesn't burn)
Place 10g of rocket around the crust like shown in the picture above & enjoy your Xmas style pizza!

recipes.title: Parmesan Potato Chips
ingredients: 25% less carbs than regular potatoes but any potatoes will work) Garlic Salt, Italian Seasoning & Cheese Seasoning (Brand: ''Deliciou'' or seasonings of choice) Water
directions: Start by cutting off the ends of the potatoes & slice them into thin slices (about as thin as paper, i used a mandoline slicer)
Fill a bowl with water (just past half way) & add 2 cups of ice then let the potatoes soak for 1 - 2 minutes. (this will remove the extra starch)
Place the potatoes on a plate with baking paper & sprinkle with garlic salt, Italian seasoning or your choice of seasonings.

Place them in the microwave for 5 - 6 minutes flipping half way, at the half way mark take them out then flip the potato slices over & add more seasonings to the other side before continuing to microwave. (everyones microwaves are different so keep an eye on them, flip when you start seeing a golden brown crispy colour on top of the potato slices - you may need to microwave them for slightly longer to ensure they are crispy)
Serve on it's own or with any low calorie dipping sauce & enjoy!

recipes.title: Buffalo Garlic Bread
ingredients: 70g Plain Flour (Brand: Vetta Smart Plain Flour - or any plain four:
10g Minced Garlic (or finely diced fresh garlic)
140g Plain Low Fat Greek Yoghurt (Brand: YoPro Plain)
12g Coconut Flour (Brand: Coco Earth Organic Flour)
2 Tbsp Franks Red Hot Buffalo Sauce (or your choice of buffalo/hot sauce)60g Low Fat/Light Cheese (Brand: Bega 50% Less Fat Grated Cheese)
directions: Start by sifting 70g of plain flour into a bowl with 12g of coconut flour & 5g of baking powder.
Mix everything together & make sure there is no lumps or clumps.
Now add 100g of egg whites & 140g of plain low fat greek yoghurt & mix everything together until you have a thick paste like texture,

Place the mixture on a baking tray with baking paper & spread it out using a wet spatula into whatever shape you want the bread to be just make sure that the mixture is not too thin. (i made mine into a rectangle)
Bake in the oven at 230 degrees celsius.
While its baking, in a small bowl mix together 70g of blended low fat cottage cheese, 2 Tbsp of buffalo sauce & 10g of minced garlic.
After 10 minutes take the base out the oven & spread the sauce on top evenly all the way to the edges of the crust.
Add 60g of low fat cheese on top then sprinkle 2 Tbsp of Italian herbs seasoning.
Bake it in the oven again for 5 - 7 minutes at the same temperature or until golden brown & enjoy!

recipes.title: Low Calorie Hawaiian Pizza
ingredients: 1 50% Lower Carb High Protein Pizza Base (Woolworths)
40g Leggo's Garlic, Onion & Herbs Pizza Sauce
directions: Start by preheating the oven to 220 degrees celsius.
While the oven is preheating, lay out the pizza base & spread 40g of pizza sauce evenly across the base then sprinkle 1 tsp of oregano on top.
Grab 20g of sliced honey leg ham, rip it apart into small pieces with your hands & place it evenly around the pizza base.
Spread 45g of low fat cheese & 60g of cubed pineapples on top. (If the cubed pineapples are too big for your liking you can cut them into even smaller pieces with a knife)
Once the hawaiian pizza is assembled, turn the oven down to 180 degrees celsius (fan forced) & bake for 10-12 minutes or until golden. (keep your eye on it every few minutes)
Take it out the oven once the pizza is cooked & enjoy!

recipes.title: Pot Honey Soy Chicken Stir Fry
ingredients: 75g Cooked White Rice Sesame Seeds & Spring Onion (optional - only added for visual representation)
directions: Start by adding 1 tsp of olive oil to a pan with the stove on high heat, once the pan is hot add 130g of diced chicken breast.

Once the chicken is nearly cooked through set it to the side of the pan, turn the heat down to medium & in the middle add 20g of chopped zucchini, 20g of chopped red onion, 50g of diced capsicum/peppers & 10g of garlic mince.
Mix the vegetables together, let them cook for 1 minute.
Add 100g of cauliflower rice to the middle with the vegetables then mix everything together including the chicken.
Add 15ml of soy & honey sauce, 30ml of light soy sauce & mix together.
Push everything to the side of the pan, add 1 egg & scramble while cooking on the empty side of the pan. After about 30 seconds start mixing everything on the pan together.

Add 75g of cooked white rice on top, mix everything together one more time then add to a bowl & enjoy! (Garnish with a sprinkle of sesame seeds & some diced spring - optional & not necessary taste wise)

recipes.title: Spicy Nandos Stir Fry
ingredients: 200g Cauliflower Rice (Brand: Coles Kitchen) Onion Powder, Garlic Salt, Cajun Seasoning (or seasonings of choice)
35g Nandos Extra Hot Peri Peri Sauce
25g Light Sweet Chilli Sauce (Brand: Ayam) Chilli, Chives, Sriracha (optional topping)
directions: Start by seasoning 150g of diced chicken breast with onion powder, garlic salt & cajun seasoning.
