Spray a pan with light cooking oil spray & cook the chicken breast on high heat.
Once the chicken is cooked set it to the side in a small bowl.

To the same pan add 75g of frozen mixed vegetables, 200g of cauliflower rice & season with onion powder, garlic salt & cajun seasoning. (don't be shy with the seasoning on this step! it is key to making the cauliflower rice have a lot of flavour)
Mix everything on the pan together & let it cook for 2 - 4 minutes.

Push the cauliflower rice & mixed vegetables to the side of the pan, crack in 1 egg & scramble it. Just before the egg is fully cooked mix it together with the cauliflower rice & mixed vegetables to create a stir fry,
Add the chicken back to the pan then add 15g of light soy sauce, 35g of nandos hot sauce, 25g of light sweet chilli sauce & gently mix everything together to combine.
Add everything to a plate & garnish with chilli, chives & sriracha (optional) Enjoy!

recipes.title: Loaded Grilled Chicken
directions: With a knife cut 4 slices on top of the chicken breast to create 4 pockets like shown in the picture above. (make sure not to cut all the way through, cut through just after half way)
Preheat the oven to 220 degrees celsius on fan grill.
For this recipe you will be using both the stove & the oven. Start by turning the stove on high heat & adding 1 tsp of olive oil to a pan.
Cook the chicken for 5 minutes on each side of the pan (or until golden brown)

Take the chicken breast & set it on a plate, let it cool for a few minutes & add 24g of mozzarella in one pocket then add 1 slice of tomato into the next pocket & repeat the process for the next 2 pockets in the chicken.
Season the chicken with 1/2 tsp paprika & 1/2 tsp of all purpose seasoning.
Place the filled chicken breast in the oven & cook for 10-15 minutes at 220 degrees celsius.
Take the chicken out the oven & sprinkle 1/2 tsp of paprika, 1/2 tsp of all purpose seasoning, 1 tsp of parsley flakes & enjoy! (can be stored in fridge)

recipes.title: High Protein Mac & Cheese
ingredients: 80g San Remo Pasta Pro Multigrain Protein Pasta
directions: Fill a large saucepan with water, put the lid on & set the stove to high heat. Add 80g of protein pasta then let it cook for 12-15 minutes.
While the pasta is cooking on a separate pan on high heat add 100ml of unsweetened almond milk, 25g of Philadelphia light cream cheese & 1 serving of light laughing cow cheese.
After 30 seconds season with 1 tsp of salt, 1/2 tsp of pepper & 1/2 tsp of parsley flakes then add 20g of light mozzarella cheese & stir slowly on medium heat for a few minutes until it thickens.

Once the cheese is bubbling & slightly thicker, strain the pasta & add it to the other pan with melted cheese & stir everything together on medium heat so the pasta & cheese combines. Keep stirring until the cheese is as thick as possible & stringy.
Sprinkle with 1/2 tsp of parsley flakes & enjoy!

recipes.title: Untitled Recipe
directions: Start by preheating the oven to 220 degrees celsius.
Weigh 250g of spud lite potatoes & cut them into french fry shapes.
Add the cut up potato into a bowl & season with 1 tsp of paprika & 1 tsp of all purpose seasoning.
Mix together to coat the fries & place on a baking tray with baking paper.
Bake the potatoes in the oven at 220 degrees celsius for 15-20 minutes. (or until golden brown & crispy)
While the potatoes are baking, in a bowl add 75g of pulled chicken & mix with 20g of Sweet Baby Rays honey chipotle sauce.
Once the potatoes are baked place them in a oven safe baking dish, Sprinkle 75g of pulled chicken on top then add 40g of low fat cheese.
Bake in the oven again at 220 degrees celsius for 5 minutes. (or until cheese has melted)
Once the cheese has melted take it out the oven & drizzle 1 Tbsp of lite sour cream & 20g of chilli sauce on top & enjoy!

recipes.title: Spicy Vegetarian Pizza
ingredients: 1 50% Lower carb High Protein Pizza Base (Woolworths)
directions: Start by preheating the oven to 220 degrees celsius.
While the oven is preheating lay out the pizza base & spread 40g of pizza sauce evenly across the base then sprinkle 1 tsp of oregano.
Spread 40g of low fat cheese evenly over the pizza base & add 55g of cherry tomatoes, 50g of red capsicum, 50g of sliced mushrooms, 5g of jalapenos & 2g of garlic on top.
Season with 1 tsp of salt & pepper then bake in the oven at 180 degrees celsius for 10-15 minutes. (or until golden brown & cheese has melted, keep an eye on the edges of the crust)
Finish off by drizzling 10g of chilli sauce over the pizza & enjoy this amazing spicy vegetarian pizza for less than 400 calories for the WHOLE pizza!

recipes.title: Low Calorie Beef Taco Boats
ingredients: 3 Stand n Stuff Taco Shells (Old El Paso)
directions: Start by weighing out 100g of raw extra lean beef mince & seasoning with 1g of vegeta (or choice of seasoning)
Using a non stick pan with the stove on high heat cook the extra lean beef mince for around 7 - 10 minutes.
While the mince is cooking chop the vegetables & get all the other ingredients ready.

Once the mince is cooked it's time to build the taco boat. Start by placing 20g of shredded iceberg lettuce at the bottom of 1 of the taco boat shells then adding 25g of cooked mince, 10g of diced tomato, 15g of low fat cheese, 5g of spring onion & top it off by drizzling 10g of Nandos perinaise sauce.
Repeat the process on step 4 to build the other 2 taco boats using the exact same measurements & enjoy!

recipes.title: Big Mac Salad
ingredients: 30g Special Burger Sauce (Coles Big Mac Sauce)
directions: Start by weighing out 150g of lean beef mince & seasoning with 1/2 tsp of salt & 1/2 tsp of pepper. (weighed raw, once cooked it will weigh about 130g)
Cook the lean beef mince on a non stick pan on high heat for around 10 minutes.
In a large bowl add 3 cups of shredded lettuce (or as much as you like as lettuce is SO low in calories)
Once the beef mince is cooked add it on top of the shredded lettuce.
Cut 30g of pickles into thin slices & spread over the salad.
Drizzle 30g of special burger sauce (Coles Big Mac Sauce) over the beef mince then top it off with 20g of low fat cheese & enjoy this amazing low calorie & high volume big mac salad!

recipes.title: Chicken Taco Boats
ingredients: 2 Stand n Stuff Taco Shells (Old El Paso)
2 Tbsp Lite Sour Cream (or greek yoghurt)
directions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees celsius.
Weigh 150g of chicken breast & season with 4g of mexican seasoning. (or choice of seasoning)
Cook the chicken breast on a stick pan with the stove on high heat. (cooking on a non stick pan is optional. It can be cooked on a normal pan with olive oil, calories will vary)
Cut the cooked chicken breast into small pieces.
Place 2 taco boats on an oven tray & bake in the oven at 180 degrees celsius for 2 minutes. (this makes the taco boats crispy, this step is optional)
In a small bowl mix together 2 Tbsp of lite sour cream & 1 tsp of paprika. (this will be the sauce)

Now it's time to build the taco boats. In 1 taco boat add 10g of rocket, 60g of chicken breast, 5g of diced red onion, 5g of diced capsicum, 1/2 diced tomato & top it off by drizzling 1 Tbsp of the lite sour cream & paprika sauce.
Repeat the process for the other taco boat by adding the leftover ingredients & enjoy!

recipes.title: Cheesy Garlic Bread Pizza
ingredients: 1 50% Lower Carb High Protein Pizza Base (Woolworths)
directions: Start by preheating the oven to 220 degrees celsius.
After a few minutes bake the pizza base in the oven at 200 degrees celsius for 5 minutes to make it nice & crispy.
In a small bowl add 1 Tbsp of olive oil, 1 tsp of garlic, 1/2 tsp of pink himalayan salt & 1 tsp of oregano then mix it all together.
Take the pizza base out the oven & spread the mixture from step 2 evenly across the pizza base.
Spread 40g of low fat cheese across the pizza base.
Cut 1 slice of smokey cheese into small pieces & spread evenly on top.
Bake in the oven again at 200 degrees celsius for 3 - 5 minutes until the cheese has melted & enjoy!

recipes.title: Protein Spicy Chicken Rice Bowl
directions: Start off by weighing out 180g of chicken breast & cutting the chicken into small cubes.
Place the chicken in a bowl & add 1 tsp of paprika, 1/2 tsp of all purpose seasoning & 1 tsp of chilli flakes then mix it all together.
Dice 50g of red onion & place it to the side for now.
Now it's time to cook the chicken. Add 1 tsp of olive oil to a pan on high heat & add the chicken once the oil is hot.
Let the chicken cook for around 10 minutes & slowly mix it around while it's cooking.
After 10 minutes add 50g of diced red onion & keep mixing while letting it cook for another 5 minutes.

Once the chicken is cooked add it to a bowl with 1 cup of cooked white rice (158g) & that's it! The chicken on its own came out to less than 300 calories & this whole meal is only 500 calories in total.

recipes.title: Untitled Recipe
ingredients: 15g Egg Whites (Or 1 egg, calories & macros will vary)
directions: Start by weighing out 150g of chicken breast & season with 1/2 tsp of salt, 1/2 tsp of pepper, 1 tsp of garlic salt & 1 tsp of paprika on each side.
Add 10g of crushed corn flakes & 10g of oat flour onto a plate & mix together with a fork.

In a separate bowl add 15g of egg whites & soak the chicken breast into the egg whites then cover each side of the chicken breast with the corn flake & oat crumbed mixture. (make sure the chicken breast is evenly coated)
Air fry the chicken breast at 200 degrees celsius for 15-17 minutes.

Now it's time to build the burger! Spread 15g of fat free mayonnaise on the bottom bun, add the chicken breast, add 15g of oak lettuce & finish by spreading the other 15g of fat free mayonnaise onto the bottom of the top bun.

recipes.title: Untitled Recipe
ingredients: 3 Cheese Corn Thins/Rice Cakes (Flavour is optional)
70g Sweet Baby Rays Buffalo Wing Sauce
directions: Snap 3 cheese corn thins/rice cakes into small pieces and add them into a blender cup with 1 tsp of garlic salt & 1 tsp of paprika then blend into a powder.
Pour the blended powder onto a plate.
In a separate small bowl add 1 egg & mix the egg together.
Cut 200g of chicken breast into small nugget/bite sized shapes.
One by one soak each piece of chicken in the egg then roll & cover the chicken completely with the powdered mixture. (this will create a crumbled like coating)
Bake at 180 degrees celsius for 15 minutes in the air fryer.
In a separate bowl add 70g of Sweet Baby Rays buffalo wing sauce.
When the chicken is ready add each piece individually into the bowl & coat with the sauce.
Once every piece has been coated in the sauce place it back into the air fryer again at 180 degrees celsius for 5 minutes.
After 5 minutes coat each piece of chicken with the leftover sauce & enjoy!

recipes.title: & High Protein Snack Idea
ingredients: 1 Chilli Tuna Can (I used the brand Sirena but you can use any brand & flavour of tuna you like)
directions: Place 5 corn thins/rice cakes onto a big plate or board.
Spread 30g of low fat cottage cheese evenly across each corn thin (5 corn thins).
Evenly spread the chilli tuna across each corn thin on top of the low fat cottage cheese. (1 can)

recipes.title: Loaded Beef Nachos
ingredients: 1 Low Calorie Wrap/Tortilla (I used Mission Low Gi+Protein Wrap)
25g Low Fat Cheese (I used Beqa 50% Less Fat Cheese)
1 Tsp Parsley Flakes Lemon Juice Avocado Oil/Low Calorie Cooking Spray (Optional)
directions: Start by spraying the wrap with a tiny bit of avocado oil/low calorie cooking spray. (optional but helps keep the seasonings sick to the wrap)
Once the wrap has been oiled cut it into strips/triangle shapes using a knife or scissors.
Season with 1 tsp of paprika & 1 tsp of garlic salt then bake in the air fryer at 180 degrees celsius for 3 minutes. (If using an oven bake for 5 minutes)
Turn the stove on high heat & using a non stick pan cook 130g of extra lean beef mince & season with 1 tsp of mexican seasoning & 1 tsp of salsa.
Cook all the way through & keep mixing gently for around 10 minutes until the meat is cooked.
Place the baked wrap strips into a oven safe bowl with the meat on top & add 25g of low fat cheese on top then bake in the air fryer/oven for 2 minutes until the cheese melts.
In a small separate bowl add 1/2 diced tomato, 10g of diced red onion, 10g of diced capsicum, 1 tsp of parsley flakes & a drop of lemon juice then mix together with a fork.

recipes.title: Loaded Beef Nachos
ingredients: 1 Low Calorie Wrap/Tortilla (I used Mission Low Gi+Protein Wrap)
25g Low Fat Cheese (I used Beqa 50% Less Fat Cheese)
1 Tsp Parsley Flakes Lemon Juice Avocado Oil/Low Calorie Cooking Spray (Optional)
directions: Once the cheese has melted on the nachos take it out the oven & add the toppings you just mixed together from step 7 on top.
Drizzle 2 Tbsp of lite sour cream over the nachos & enjoy!

recipes.title: Chicken Parmigiana
directions: Start by weighing 140g of chicken breast & beat to flatten. (I used a wooden dough roller)
In a blender cup add 1 cheese corn thin, 1/2 tsp of salt, 1/2 tsp of pepper, 1 tsp of garlic salt & 1 tsp of paprika then blend together for 1 minute.
Once blended pour the corn thin mixture onto a plate & in a separate bowl add 35g of egg whites.
Preheat the oven at 200 degrees celsius.

Soak the chicken breast in the egg whites then place it on the plate with the blended corn thin & coat evenly, this will create the coating for the chicken breast. (make sure the chicken breast is coated on each side)
Bake the chicken breast in the oven at 220 degrees celsius for 20 minutes. (flip over half way through at the 10 minute mark)

recipes.title: Chicken Parmigiana
directions: Once the chicken is cooked add 35g of pizza sauce on top & 25g of light mozzarella cheese.
Bake in the oven again at 220 degrees celsius for 5 minutes until the cheese has melted & enjoy!

recipes.title: Cheesy Garlic Bread
ingredients: 6 English Breakfast Muffins (I used the brand TipTop)
20g Light Margarine/Butter (I used Nuttelex Lite Margarine)
directions: Start by breaking each english breakfast muffin in half (6 muffins) then cut both slices of each muffin in half (this will create 4 slices instead of 2 for each breakfast muffin)
Preheat the oven at 200 degrees celsius.
In a small bowl mix together 20g of light margarine/butter, 1 diced garlic clove, 2g of rosemary leaves, 2g of parsley flakes & 1 tsp of garlic salt.
Spread the margarine/butter mix evenly across each english breakfast slice (12 slices in total)
One by one place 10g of light mozzarella onto 6 of the cut up slices & place the other 6 slices on top to create 6 sandwiches like shown in the picture above.

Add aluminum foil into a oven safe baking dish/tray & place all english muffins inside in a long single file line. (like shown in the picture above, make sure they are tight together & won't fall over)

recipes.title: Cheesy Garlic Bread
ingredients: 6 English Breakfast Muffins (I used the brand TipTop)
20g Light Margarine/Butter (I used Nuttelex Lite Margarine)
directions: Bake in the oven at 180 degrees celsius for 10 - 15 minutes & enjoy! (or until the cheese has melted & the edges are crispy)

recipes.title: Low Calorie Meat Free Tortilla Pizza
ingredients: 1 Low Calorie Wrap/Tortilla (I used Mission Low GI + Protein Wrap)
50g Cherry Tomatoes (cut each one in half)
30g Garlic, Onion & Herbs Pizza Sauce (I used Leggo's)
directions: Start by preheating the oven at 200 degrees celsius.
Once the oven is hot place the low calorie wrap/tortilla onto an oven tray & bake for 2 - 4 minutes at 180 degrees celsius. (this will make the wrap crispy & will stop it from being floppy)
When the wrap is nice & crispy take it out the oven & spread 30g of pizza sauce evenly all the way to the edges.
Sprinkle 1/2 tsp of oregano then add 20g of baby spinach, 50g of cherry tomatoes (cut each one in half), 50g of chopped mushrooms, 25g of light mozzarella & 45g of bocconcini cheese.
Bake in the oven again at 180 degrees for 5 - 10 minutes or until the cheese has melted & enjoy!

recipes.title: Untitled Recipe
ingredients: 1 Low Calorie Wrap/Tortilla (I used Mission Lite Wrap) *Has to be a bigger wrap due to how it will be folded*
3g All Purpose Seasoning (or seasoning of choice)
directions: Start by cooking 120g of extra lean beef mince on a non stick pan with the stove on high heat.
When the mince is about half way cooked add 3g of all purpose seasoning & keep mixing while the mince is cooking through.
Once the mince has cooked completely place it in the middle of the wrap in a circle & then on top add 25g of light mozzarella cheese, 1/2 diced tomato, 10g of diced red onion & 20g of baby spinach.

Now it's time to fold the wrap & this part may be a little tricky with the fingers. Tightly fold the edges up of the wrap over to the center, holding each fold whilst working all the way around the wrap.
Cook the wrap on a non stick pan with the stove on high heat for 2 - 3 minutes on each side until golden brown & enjoy! (you could also use a sandwich toaster)

recipes.title: Big Mac Loaded Fries
ingredients: 35g Low Fat Cheese (i used Bega 50% Less Fat Grated Cheese)
20g Coles Special Burger Sauce (Big Mac Sauce)
2g All Purpose Seasoning (or seasoning of choice)
directions: Start by weighing out 250g of potatoes & cutting them into french fry shapes.
Preheat the oven to 200 degrees celsius.
Place the potatoes in a bowl, add 2g of all purpose seasoning & mix well.
Place the potatoes on an oven tray with baking paper & bake in the oven at 220 degrees celsius for 15 - 20 minutes or until cooked. (spud lite potatoes cook quicker than regular potatoes)
While the potatoes are cooking season 150g of extra lean beef mince with 1 tsp of salt & pepper.
Cook the mince on a non stick pan with the stove on high heat.
Once the potatoes & mince are cooked place the potatoes in an oven safe baking dish with the mince on top.
Sprinkle 35g of low fat cheese on top & bake in the oven again for 5 minutes at 220 degrees celsius or until the cheese has melted.

recipes.title: Big Mac Loaded Fries
ingredients: 35g Low Fat Cheese (i used Bega 50% Less Fat Grated Cheese)
20g Coles Special Burger Sauce (Big Mac Sauce)
2g All Purpose Seasoning (or seasoning of choice)
directions: Finish off by adding 10g of diced red onion, 15g of sliced pickles & 20g of Coles special burger sauce. Enjoy!

recipes.title: Healthy Breakfast Burger
ingredients: 25g Low Fat Cheese (i used Bega 50% less fat grated cheese)
20g Sliced Honey Leg Ham (Brand: Don, 2 Slices)
1 High Fibre Low GI Soft Round Roll (Coles)
directions: Start by weighing out 100g of extra lean beef mince & form into two 50g patties.
Season the patties with 1 tsp of salt & 1 tsp of pepper then place 25g of low fat cheese in the middle of 1 patty.
Place one patty on top of another & press down on the edges to seal the patties together.
Cook the patty on a non stick pan on high heat for 5 minutes on each side. (or using a normal pan with olive oil)
Using the same pan cook 1 egg & 20g of sliced honey leg ham.
Once everything is cooked it's time to build the burger! Grab the bread roll & add 1 tbsp of sriracha, 15g of baby spinach & the rest of the ingredients that were cooked in the steps above.

recipes.title: Biscoff Cookie Dough
ingredients: 200ml Unsweetened Almond Milk (or your choice of milk - you may need to use more or less depending on the protein powder, make sure to add it slowly until you reach the right consistency)
45g Vegan Protein Powder (Brand: Macro Mike Vanilla Buttercream)
directions: In a bowl add 45g of vegan protein powder, 15g of powdered peanut butter, 5g of natural sweetener & a dash of salt then mix to avoid clumping.

Slowly pour the milk into the bowl while mixing everything together (you may need to use more or less depending on the protein powder, make sure to add it slowly while mixing until you reach the right consistency)
Add 10g of melted biscoff spread into the bowl with 10g of chocolate chips & half a crushed biscoff biscuit.
Mix everything together & add the other half of the crushed biscoff biscuit on top.
To make the texture even thicker & closer to a real cookie dough place it in the fridge for 15 - 25 minutes. (optional but preferred)

recipes.title: Snickers Donuts
ingredients: 100g Low Fat Greek Yoghurt(flavoured or plain - I used YoPro Salted Caramel. If usingplain add more sweetener or flavour drops)3g Baking Powder
20g Sweetener (such as monkfruit, stevia, erythritol etc - I used Whole Earth Monkfruit)5g Powdered Peanut Butter With Cocoa or Regular CocoaPowder
6g Hersheys Caramel Sauce(each donut - or sugar free caramel sauce) Sauceany chocolate sauce) (optional, you can use
15g Chocolate Protein Powder(Brand: Rule1 Chocolate Fudge)
6g Cocoa Powder80 - 100 ml Unsweetened Almond Milk (slowly add themilk while mixing, you may need to use more or lessdepending on the protein powder until you get theperfect texture/consistency)
directions: In a bowl crack in 1 egg then add 40g of oat flour, 100g of low fat greek yoghurt, 3g of baking powder, 20g of sweetener, 5g of PB2 or cocoa powder & 1 Tsp of caramel or vanilla flavour drops.
Mix everything together & pour the mixture evenly into a 6 cup non stick donut baking tray (if you have a regular baking tray spray with light cooking oil spray beforehand so they don't stick)
Bake in the oven at 180 degrees celsius for 15 minutes.

While thats baking to make the chocolate protein sauce in a bowl mix together 15g of chocolate protein powder, 3g of cocoa powder & slowly add 80ml of unsweetened almond milk while mixing until you have a thick consistency.
Add another 3g of cocoa powder & mix one more time, doing it in this order will give you a creamy thick sauce.
Once the donuts are baked let them cool for 10 minutes then take them out, flip them over & coat the top of each donut in the chocolate sauce.
Add 3g of crushed peanuts to each donut, drizzle 6g of caramel sauce & enjoy! Store in the fridge.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Rolls
ingredients: 115g Self Raising Flour (Brand: Vetta Smart Protein Self Raising Flour but any self raising flour works)
130g Plain or Flavoured Low Fat Greek Yoghurt (Brand: YoPro Plain)
30g Brown Sugar Stevia (Brand: Natvia Natural Brown Sweetener, or your choice of sweetener)
directions: Start by sifting 115g of self raising flour into a bowl then add 130g of low fat greek yoghurt & mix everything together with a spoon for a few minutes until combined, depending on the type of Greek yogurt you use, you may need to add a little more flour if its too sticky.
Place the dough on a lightly floured kitchen surface then knead & form into a ball.
Using a rolling pin, roll the dough out into a thin layered rectangle shape.

Using a pastry brush spread 35ml of sugar free maple syrup evenly across the dough then sprinkle 2 Tbsp of cinnamon on top. (if you use too much syrup it will cause the roll to be too moist & it will fall apart)
Roll the dough starting from the shorter side of the rectangle then cut it into 6 even pieces.
Bake in the oven at 180 degrees celsius for 20 minutes & enjoy!

recipes.title: Biscoff Cheesecake
ingredients: 150g Light Cream Cheese (Brand: Philadelphia Light 40% Less Fat)
400g Low Fat Greek Yoghurt (Brand YoPro Vanilla - I highly suggest using a flavoured yoghurt, you can use plain but add more sweetener/vanilla extract)
15g Stevia (Brand: Natvia - or choice of sweetener)
1.5 Servings Protein Powder (Brand: Rule1 Vanilla Creme)
directions: In a blender cup add 150g of light cream cheese, 400g of low fat greek yoghurt, 1 egg, 1 tsp of vanilla extract, 15g of stevia, 1 tbsp of biscoff spread, 100g of low fat cottage cheese, 1.5 servings of protein powder & blend until smooth.
Pour the mixture into a baking dish with baking paper (I used a 20 x 5cm round cake dish)
Bake it in the oven at 200 degrees celsius for 25 - 30 min.
Once baked set in the fridge for 1 hour to cool.
While the cake is cooling, in a small bowl add 1 tbsp of biscoff spread & 60ml of unsweetened almond milk then microwave it for 20 seconds.
Using a spoon stir the milk & biscoff together, after about 1 minute add 1 more tbsp of biscoff spread & keep stirring until you have a creamy sauce.
Once the cake is cooled spread the sauce evenly on top of the cake.
Sprinkle 3 crushed biscoff biscuits around the edges, cut into 6 even pieces & enjoy!

recipes.title: Strawberry Cheesecake
ingredients: 150g Light Cream Cheese(Brand: Philadelphia 40% Less Fat Light Cream Cheese)1 Egg
1 Tsp Vanilla Extract400g Low Fat Greek Yoghurt (Brand: YoPro Vanilla - use plainor flavoured if available, if using plain add a bit moresweetener/vanilla extract)
15g Sweetener (Brand: WholeEarth Monkfruit Sweetener - or your choice of sweetener suchas stevia)

40g Protein Powder (Brand:Rule1 Vanilla Crème - you can use any flavour but vanilla orstrawberry would work best) Toppings (optional &customisable) Strawberry Glaze (200g frozenstrawberries mixed with 35g of sweetener - add 5g of cornflour/ cornstarch mixed with water to thicken)1 Crushed Biscuit (Brand: Digestives Biscuits - or grahamcrackers)

recipes.title: Biscoff Banana Bread
ingredients: 100ml Unsweetened Almond Milk (or your choice of milk)
60g Plain Flour (Brand: Vetta Smart Plain Flour)
60g Vanilla Protein Powder (Brand: Rule1 Vanilla Crème)
20g Sweetener (Brand: Whole Earth Monkfruit Sweetener - or your choice of sweetener) Cinnamon (optional)
15g Melted Biscoff Spread (spread on mixture before baking)
15g Melted Biscoff Spread (add on top of frosting once bread is cooled) Topping (optional)
130g Low Fat Greek Yoghurt (vanilla or plain)
directions: In a bowl add 2 bananas & mash them up thenadd 100ml of almond milk, 1 Tsp of vanilla extract & mix it together.2. In a seperate bowl add 60g of plain flour, 60g of vanilla protein powder, 1 Tsp of baking powder, 20gof sweetener, a dash of cinnamon & mix it together.
Combine the wet & dry ingredients together thenmix it all to combine.

Pour the mixture into a lined loaf baking tin.5. In a small bowl melt 15g of biscoff spread then pour it over the mixture.6. Using a knife or fork swivel the melted biscoff spread gently around the mixture.7. Bake it in the oven at 180 degrees celsius for 25 minutes.8. While the bread is baking in a small bowl mix together 130g of low fat greek yoghurt & 20g ofvanilla protein powder. This will be the protein frosting.9. Let the bread cool down for around 10 - 15 minutes, take it out of the tin & spread the frostingevenly on top.
Melt another 15g of biscoff spread & drizzle it on top of the frosting.11. Top it off with 1 crushed biscoff biscuit then cut into 10 equal slices & enjoy!

recipes.title: Untitled Recipe
ingredients: 1/2 Serving Protein Powder (i used Vanilla Creme by Rule1)
3 Slices Low Calorie Bread (Brand: Country Split)
directions: In a bowl add 1 egg, 200g egg whites, 2 tbsp sugar free maple syrup, 2g baking powder, 50ml unsweetened almond milk, 1/2 serving protein powder, 10g stevia & mix everything together.
Spray a small oven safe baking dish with a tiny bit of non stick spray & pour the mixture inside.
Microwave 110g of frozen mixed berries for 1 minute then add them to the baking dish.
Rip 3 slices of low calorie bread into small pieces & add that to the mixture as well.
Bake in the oven at 200 degrees celsius for 30-35 minutes.
Once baked add 100g of vanilla yoghurt on top with 30g of microwaved frozen mixed berries & enjoy! Store in fridge if needed.

recipes.title: Untitled Recipe
ingredients: 400g Flavoured Low Fat Greek Yoghurt (Brand: YoPro Vanilla - you can use plain but add 2 Tbsp of vanilla extract)
80 Blueberries (or as much as you'd like)
directions: In a bowl add 400g of flavoured low fat greek yoghurt, 4 eggs, sift in 40g of corn flour, 20g of stevia, & 80g of blueberries.
Mix everything together.
Pour the mixture into a bake dish/ cake pan with baking paper. (I used a 21.5cm cake dish)
Bake it in the oven at 180 degrees celsius for 50 minutes.
Take it out, let it cool outside for 5 minutes then leave it in the fridge for another hour.
Cut into 4 equal slices & enjoy!

recipes.title: Chocolate & Pb Cake
ingredients: 15g Chocolate Protein Powder (Brand: Rule1 Chocolate Fudge)
15g Powdered Peanut Butter - or your choice of topping (Brand: PB2)
80g Egg Whites (this will ONLY work if you use real egg whites from an actual egg, this will NOT work if you use egg whites from a carton, box etc)
directions: First start off by separating 2 egg whites from the egg yolks & placing the egg whites in a large bowl. (2 egg weigh approximately 80g, you may need to use 1 more depending on the size of the egg)
In the same big bowl add 5g of cocoa powder, 15g of stevia, 5g of baking powder & 15g of chocolate protein powder (or your choice of flavour)
Using an electric hand mixer whisk everything together for a few minutes until peaks form.
Once peaks form then add 15g of chocolate protein powder & very gently mix everything together until combined.
Place the mixture into a bowl & microwave for 1 - 2 minutes. (keep an eye on it & take it out every 30 seconds)
In a small bowl add 2 Tbsp of water & 15g of powdered peanut butter, start mixing & gradually add water and continue mixing until you have your desired texture.
Drizzle the sauce on top of the cake & enjoy!

recipes.title: Biscoff Donuts
ingredients: 100g Low Fat Greek Yoghurt (plain or flavoured, i used YoPro Vanilla - If using plain add more vanilla extract)
1 packet of snack sized biscoff biscuits)
directions: In a bowl add 1 egg, 40g of oat flour, 2g of baking powder, 100g of low fat greek yoghurt, 1 tsp of vanilla extract & 15g of stevia.
Mix everything together.
Pour the mixture into a non stick donut baking tray (if using a regular donut baking tray lightly grease it with cooking oil spray - the donut tray i use has 6 donut cups)
Bake it in the oven at 180 degrees celsius for 15 - 17 minutes.
While that's baking, in a small bowl add 1 Tbsp of biscoff spread & 20ml of unsweetened almond milk then microwave it for 30 seconds.
Once microwaved stir & mix it together to turn it into a thick sauce.
When the donuts are ready take them out & let them cool for 10 minutes before taking them out the tray.
Once cooled, one by one coat the top each donut evenly in the biscoff spread & finish it off by sprinking 1 serving of crushed biscoff biscuits across all the donuts & enjoy!

ingredients: 150g Light Cream Cheese (Brand: Philadelphia 40% Less Fat Cream Cheese)
400g Low Fat Greek Yoghurt (Brand: YoPro Vanilla - if using a plain flavour, add more vanilla extract or sweetener)
15g Stevia (Brand: Natvia Natural Sweetener - or your choice of sweetener)
40g Protein Powder (Brand: Rule1 Vanilla Crème - or your choice of flavour)
1 Crushed Biscuit/Graham Cracker (Brand: McVities Digestive Biscuits)
20g Melted White Chocolate [optional) (Brand: Well Naturally No Added Sugar White Chocolate)

Add 50g of fresh blueberries into the mixture &mix it around.
Bake in the oven at 200 degrees celsius for 25 -30 minutes.

Once baked take it out & set it in the fridge for 1hour (it might be a little bit jiggly but will harden in the fridge)6. While the cake is cooling in the fridge to a pan on high heat add 150g of frozen blueberries. Mix & cookfor 5 - 10 minutes so that the blueberries soften.

recipes.title: Blueberry Cheesecake Rolls
ingredients: 250g Self Raising Flour (Brand: Vetta Smart Self Raising Flour - or regular flour mixed with
15g Vanilla Protein Powder (Brand: Rule1 Vanilla Creme)
directions: In a bowl add 250g of self raising flour, 270g of plain greekyoghurt & mix it together.
Using your hands knead for around 5 minutes to form adough.
On a lightly floured surface roll the dough out using arolling pin into a large rectangle shape.

Then to a pan on high heat add 150g of frozenblueberries, let them cook until they soften & start releasing moisture.5. Add 20g of sweetener, mix it together then slowly add 5g of cornflour mixed with water while mixing. Keep addingthe water in slowly & mixing until you have a thick consistency.6. Leave the blueberries to the side & let them cool.
In a seperate bowl add 40g of light cream cheese & 2 Tspof vanilla extract then mix it all together until it softens.
Gently spread the cream cheese evenly across the dough.9. Spread the blueberries evenly on top of the cream cheese.10. Roll the dough up & cut it into 8 even pieces.
Place them on a baking tray with baking paper & lightlypress them down using your hands, this will stretch them ever so slightly to make them wider.

Bake at 180 degrees celsius for 20 - 24 minutes13. While they are baking in a seperate bowl mix together 15g of protein powder & 80g of vanilla yoghurt until smooth.14. Spread the sauce evenly across each roll once baked & enjoy!

recipes.title: Biscoff Lava Cake
ingredients: 1 Serving Chocolate Protein Powder (Brand: Rule1 Chocolate Fudge)
24g Powdered Peanut Butter With Cocoa (or regular powdered peanut butter)
directions: In a bowl add 1 serving of chocolate protein powder, 2g of baking powder, 24g of powdered peanut butter with cocoa & mix the dry ingredients together.
Pour 100ml of unsweetened almond milk into the bowl then mix the dry & wet ingredients together to combine.
Pour the mixture into a bowl & microwave for around 1-2 minutes.
Add 1 crushed biscoff biscuit on top then drizzle 15g of melted biscoff spread & enjoy!

recipes.title: Low Calorie Oreo Donuts
ingredients: 1/2 Serving Protein Powder (I used Cookies & Cream flavour but any flavour works)
directions: In a bowl add 1/2 tsp of cocoa powder, 1 egg, 90g of vanilla yoghurt, 10g of stevia, 40g of oat flour, 1/2 tsp of baking soda & a dash of salt. Mix well to combine.
Pour the mixture into a non stick donut baking tray (or regular donut baking tray with non stick spray)
Bake in the oven at 180 degrees celsius for 15 minutes (let the donuts cool for 5 minutes before taking them out the donut tray)
While the donuts are baking crush 2 oreos on a seperate plate
Grab another plate & add 1/2 serving of protein powder with 50g of vanilla yoghurt then mix it together. (this will be your frosting & the crushed oreos will be the topping)
One by one dip the top of each donut into the frosting then into the crushed oreos & that's it, enjoy!

recipes.title: Strawberry Cheesecake Rolls
ingredients: 110g Self Raising Flour (Brand: Vetta Smart Protein Self Raising Flour but any self raising flour works)
130g Plain or Flavoured Low Fat Greek Yoghurt (Brand: YoPro Plain)
directions: Start by sifting 110g of self raising flour into a bowl then add 130g of low fat greek yoghurt & mix everything together with a spoon for a few minutes until combined, depending on the type of Greek yogurt you use, you may need to add a little more flour if its too sticky.
Place the dough on a lightly floured kitchen surface then knead & form into a ball.
Using a rolling pin, roll the dough out into a thin layered rectangle shape.
In a small bowl add 40g of diced strawberries & 15g of stevia, microwave it for 1 - 2 minutes taking it out every 30 seconds & mushing it with a fork until it is as smooth as possible.
Now add 40g of light cream cheese into the same bowl & mix everything together until you have a thick creamy sauce.
Roll the dough starting from the shorter side of the rectangle then cut it into 6 even pieces.
Bake in the oven at 180 degrees celsius for 20 minutes & enjoy!

recipes.title: Protein Biscoff Mug Cake
ingredients: 20g Chocolate Whey Protein Powder (Brand: Rule 1 Chocolate Fudge)
40ml Unsweetened Almond Milk (or your choice of milk)
directions: In a small mug/bowl add 10g of oat flour, 20g of chocolate protein powder, 5g of cocoa powder, 1/2 tsp of baking powder & 40ml of unsweetened almond milk.
Mix everything together with a spoon until there is no clumps.

Add 1 Tsp of biscoff spread in the middle & microwave for 45 seconds - 1 minute (keep an eye on it as all microwaves have different settings but 45 seconds is the perfect time for most microwaves, if it starts to overflow stop the microwave & let it cool before pressing continue if needed)
Take it out the microwave & set to the side, in a seperate small bowl add 1 Tsp of biscoff spread & microwave it for 30 seconds. This will be your topping.
Spread the melted biscoff on top of the mug cake & finish it off by adding 1 crushed biscoff biscuit on top, enjoy!

recipes.title: Cherry Crumble
ingredients: 30g Stevia (Brand: Natvia - or your choice of sweetner)
directions: Start by defrosting the frozen cherries on your counter bench, while they're defrosting blend 60g of oats to create oat flour & crush 5 biscuits/crackers in a sandwich bag.
Preheat the oven to 200 degrees celsius.
Place 500g of pitted cherries into a bowl with 30g of stevia & mix well.

Pour the cherries into a baking dish & spread them out evenly making sure they are all still touching. (the size of my baking dish is 11cm x 7cm - make sure the dish you are using isn't too big, if the cherries are too far spread apart & not touching the dish is too big & they won't stick to each other)
In a bowl mix together 5 crushed biscuits & 50ml of sugar free maple syrup (slowly add the maple syrup while mixing making sure it does not get too sticky)
Sprinkle the crushed biscuits on top of the cherries.
Bake it in the oven at 200 degrees celsius for 20 - 30 Minutes (or until the biscuits are golden brown)
Take it out & divide it into 6 even pieces using a spatula, this can be eaten on its own or served with a low calorie ice cream such as halo top, enjoy!

recipes.title: Oreo Cheesecake
ingredients: 150g Light Cream Cheese (Brand: Philadelphia Light 40% Less Fat)
400g Low Fat Greek Yoghurt (Brand YoPro Vanilla - the protein powder, chocolate sauce & oreos give it enough sweetness without needing to add additional sweeteners or flavour drops)
2 Servings Protein Powder (Brand: Muscle Nation Cookies & Cream)
1 Serving Chocolate Protein Powder (Brand: Rule1 Chocolate Fudge)
directions: In a blender cup add 150g of light cream cheese, 400g of low fat greek yoghurt, 2 servings of cookies & cream protein powder, 1 egg, 100g of low fat cottage cheese & blend for 1 - 2 minutes until smooth.
Pour the mixture into a baking dish with baking paper (I used a 20 x 5cm round cake dish)
Bake it in the oven at 200 degrees celsius for 25 - 30 min.
Once baked set in the fridge for 1 hour to cool.
While the cake is cooling, in a small bowl add 1 serving of chocolate protein powder, 5g of cocoa powder, 60ml of unsweetened almond milk & stir gently until well combines & there is no clumps.

Once the sauce is smooth & creamy add another 5g of cocoa powder then mix again until there is no clumps. (make sure to follow the the procedure for step 5 & 6 correctly - this is important & will create a thick & creamy sauce)
Once the cake is cooled down spread the sauce evenly across the cake.
Sprinkle 3 crushed oreos around the edges of the cake.
Set in the fridge for another 30 minutes then slice into 6 even pieces & enjoy!

recipes.title: Nutella Donuts
ingredients: 90g Melted Nutella (15g on each donut) Monkfruit Sugar Free Icing Powder (optional)
directions: In a bowl add 40g of oat flour, 1 egg, 100g of vanilla yoghurt, 1 tbsp of stevia, 1/2 tsp of baking soda & mix well to combine.
Pour the mixture into a non stick donut baking tray (or regular donut baking tray with non stick spray)
Bake in the oven at 180 degrees celsius for 15 minutes (let the donuts cool for 5 minutes before taking them out the donut tray)
Melt 90g of nutella in the microwave
Take the donuts out the baking tray & lightly sprinkle sugar free icing powder across the donuts (optional)
Drizzle 15g of melted nutella across each donut (6 donuts in total) & enjoy!

recipes.title: Protein Birthday Cake Fruit Bowl
ingredients: 300g Low Fat Greek Yoghurt (Brand: YoPro Vanilla - or plain yoghurt)
20g Chocolate Protein Powder (Brand: Rule1 Chocolate Fudge)
1 Fibre One Birthday Cake Bar (or any fibre 1 bar flavour)
directions: In a bowl add 300g of low fat greek yoghurt & 20g of chocolate protein powder then mix it together for 1 - 2 minutes until you have a smooth & creamy consistency.
Add 50g of blueberries & 50g of diced strawberries.
Use your fingers to break apart the fibre one bar into small pieces then sprinkle it on top & enjoy!

recipes.title: Double Chocolate M&M Donuts
ingredients: 100g Low Fat Greek Yoghurt (Brand: YoPro Vanilla)
10g Chocolate Protein Powder (Brand: Rule1 Chocolate Fudge) Water
directions: In a bowl add 40g of oat flour, 1 egg, 5g of cocoa powder, a dash of salt, 10g of stevia, 1 tsp of vanilla extract, 100g of low fat greek yoghurt, 2g of baking powder & mix everything together.
Pour the mixture evenly into a non stick donut baking tray (I used a 6 cup non stick donut baking tray - if using a regular donut baking tray lightly spray with cooking oil spray to avoid sticking)
Bake it in the oven at 180 degrees celsius for 15 minutes.
While the donuts are baking in a small bowl add 10g of cocoa powder, 10g of chocolate protein powder & slowly add water while mixing until you have a thick consistency.
Let the donuts cook for 5 minutes before taking them out then spread the sauce from step 4 evenly across the top of each donut.
Evenly distribute 25g of mini chocolate m&m's on top of all the donuts & enjoy!

recipes.title: Untitled Recipe
ingredients: 20g Vanilla Protein Powder (or flavlour of choice)
1 Tsp Brown Sugar Stevia (or any sweetener)
1 Serving No Added Sugar White Chocolate
directions: In a small bowl/mug add 30ml of unsweetened almond milk, 20g of vanilla protein powder, 15g of oat flour, 1/2 tsp of baking powder, 2 tbsp of sugar free maple syrup, 1 tsp of brown sugar stevia, 10g of diced strawberries & mix together.
Place 1 serving of no added sugar white chocolate in the middle of the mug & microwave for 45 seconds - 1 minute.
Once cooked add 10g of diced strawberries on top, 3g of brown sugar stevia (optional) & enjoy!

recipes.title: Protein Cereal Fruit Bowl
ingredients: 250g Protein Yoghurt (i used strawberry flavour by YoPro)
45g Milo Protein Cereal (or any protein cereal)
1 Serving Protein Powder (i used vanilla creme by ''Rule1'')
directions: In a bowl add 250g of protein yoghurt and 1 serving of protein powder then mix together.
Add 30g of blueberries, 50g of chopped strawberries & finish off by adding 45g of milo protein cereal.

recipes.title: Low Calorie Pb & J Toasted Sandwich
ingredients: 4 Slices ''Country Split'' Bread (or any low calorie bread of choice)
2 Servings (24g) ''Marmadukes'' Powdered Peanut Butter (or any brand of powdered peanut butter)
directions: In a small cup add 2 servings of powdered peanut butter & 2 Tbsp of sugar free maple syrup then mix it together with a spoon until it is a thick consistency similar to peanut butter. (add the sugar free maple syrup slowly while mixing to create your desired texture)
Once you have made the mixture spread 1/2 of the powdered peanut butter spread onto one slice of bread & then spread 30g of 95% less sugar strawberry fruit spread on top.
Repeat the process on step 2 for the other slice of bread. (2 slices with powdered peanut butter mixture & fruit spread and the other 2 slices without anything)
Place each slice of bread together to form a sandwich.
Bake in the oven/air fryer at 200 degrees celcius for 5 minutes & enjoy!

recipes.title: Chocolate Lava Cake
ingredients: 1 Serving Chocolate Protein Powder (i used the brand ''Rule1'')
1/2 Serving Powdered Peanut Butter Mixed With Water
1 Serving Halo Top Plant Based Caramel Choc Pretzel Ice Cream Topping: (optional & customisable)
directions: In a bowl add 10g of cocoa powder, 25g of powdered peanut butter, 3g of baking powder & 1 serving of chocolate protein powder.
Mix the dry ingredients together with a fork then add 100ml of unsweetened almond milk & mix again for 20 seconds.
Pour the mixture into a smaller oven safe bowl/dish & microwave for 1 minute. (or 1:30 if it is still too liquidy)
Mix 1/2 serving of powdered peanut butter with a few drops of water & keep mixing and adding water slowly until you have a peanut butter like texture.
Add 1 serving of Halo Top ice cream & the powdered peanut butter mixture as the topping. (toppings are optional & customisable to your liking)

recipes.title: Low Calorie Sour Candy Grapes
ingredients: 350g Washed Grated (you can use any amount you like)
2 Packets Sugar Free/Lite Jelly (you can use any flavour, I used Raspberry)
3 Tbsp Lime Juice (you can add more or less depending on how sour you would like them)
directions: Start by washing 350g of grapes & adding them into a bowl.
Add 3 Tbsp of lime juice into the bowl & mix it together.
Sprinkle 1 packet of sugar free jelly powder onto the grapes & mix them again to coat all the grapes evenly.
Sprinkle the other packet on top of the grapes. (1 box comes with 2 packets)
Place in the freezer for around 1 hour & enjoy! These sour candy grapes are a great alternative to regular sour candy.

recipes.title: Protein Iced Coffee
ingredients: 1.5 Tbsp Nescafé Gold Instant Coffee (Or your choice of coffee powder)
1 Serving Protein Powder (your choice of flavour & brand. I use ''Rule1'' Salted Caramel or Chocolate Fudge)
2 Tbsp Natvia Gold Sweetener (brown sugar alternative & optional for a sweeter taste)
directions: First start by boiling a jug of water.
While the water is boiling add 1 serving of protein powder to a protein shaker bottle. (or if you don't have a shaker you can use a normal cup)
Pour 100ml of unsweetened almond milk (or your choice of milk) into the shaker bottle.
Shake the bottle to create a protein shake & set it aside for now. (mix with a spoon if using a normal cup, but make sure to mix well so there is no clumps)
By now the water should be hot & ready. Grab the main coffee cup & add 1.5 Tbsp of instant coffee.
Pour boiling water into the coffee cup till it reaches about 1/3 of the cup & mix well with a spoon.
Add 1 cup of ice to the coffee.
Pour the protein shake you mixed earlier into the coffee cup.
Add 2 Tbsp of Natvia gold sweetener. (Optional for the ones that love sweetness)
Add your choice of toppings or drink as it is. This is a quick way to get your energy in for the day AND your protein all at once!

recipes.title: Strawberry Cake
ingredients: 100ml Unsweetened Almond Milk (or milk of choice)
1 Serving Protein Powder (i used Vanilla Creme by ''Rule1'')
10g Natural Sweetener (stevia, or sweetener of choice)
110g Egg Whites (or 2 large eggs but macros will vary)
5ml Olive Oil (stops the cake from being dry & keeps it moist)
100g YoPro Vanilla Protein Yoghurt (or yoghurt of choice)
directions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees celsius.
In a bowl add 40g of oat flour, 100ml of unsweetened almond milk, 1 serving of protein powder, 10g of natural sweetener/stevia, 1/2 tsp of baking powder, 110g of egg whites & 5ml of olive oil.
Mix everything together & pour the mixture into a non stick oven baking dish. (or regular baking dish with baking paper)
Bake in the oven at 200 degrees celsius for 15 minutes.
While the caking is baking, in a separate bowl add 50g of strawberries & 5g of natural sweetener/stevia.
Microwave the bowl of strawberries for 1 minute, take it out & mix it around with a fork then put it back in the microwave for another 45 seconds - 1 minute.
Add 100g of vanilla protein yoghurt to the bowl of microwaved strawberries & mix well. (this will create the sauce on top of the cake)
Take the cake out the oven & let it cool for 5 minutes then pour the strawberry sauce on top.
Add 30g of sliced strawberries as the topping & that's it, enjoy! (can be stored in fridge)

recipes.title: Oats
directions: In a bowl add 50g of oats & pour water into the bowl until the oats are covered. (the key to having the best consistency for the protein oats is to make sure you do not overfill the bowl with too much water, fill until the water is leveled with the oats)
Microwave the oats for 2 minutes.
Once the oats are ready take the bowl out & let it cool for 1 minute.
Add 30ml of unsweetened almond milk to the bowl.
Add 1 serving of protein powder. (Rule1 Vanilla Creme is my favourite for oats)
Mix the protein powder & oats gently with a spoon until combined.
Sprinkle 10g of Natvia brown sugar stevia on top. (makes it extra sweet & only 0.5 calories per serving)
Add 60g of chopped strawberries, 40g of fresh blueberries & enjoy!

recipes.title: Chocolate Mug-Cake
ingredients: 20g Vanilla Protein Powder (or any flavour you like, I used the brand ''Rule1'')
1 Serving No Added Sugar Dark Chocolate/Milk Chocolate (Brand: Well Naturally)
4g Powdered Peanut Butter mixed with 1 tsp water. (Optional Topping)
directions: In a mug/bowl add 10g of oat flour (blended oats) followed by 20g of protein powder, 5g of cocoa powder, 1/2 tsp of baking powder, 2 Tbsp of sugar free maple syrup, 40ml of unsweetened almond milk & mix it all together until there is no clumps.

Now add 1 serving of no added sugar dark chocolate in the middle of the mixture & microwave for 45 seconds. (keep an eye on it as all microwaves have different settings but 45 seconds is the perfect time for most microwaves, if it starts to overflow stop the microwave & let it cool before pressing continue if needed)

Mix 4g of PB2 (powdered peanut butter) with about 1 tsp of water or until desired texture, if you like peanut butter more runny use more & slowly keep adding water while mixing (powdered peanut butter is an optional topping)
Pour the PB2 on top of the mug-cake & enjoy! The middle will be filled with melted chocolate. This is the perfect recipe for someone craving a quick sweet tooth snack.

recipes.title: Biscoff Protein Balls
ingredients: 2 Servings Vanilla Protein Powder (Or any flavour)
1 Serving Melted No Added Sugar Dark Chocolate Sprinkle Of Oat Flour (Optional) Toppings:
directions: In a big bowl add 60g of oat flour, 2 servings of vanilla protein powder, 80g of biscoff spread, 20ml of unsweetened almond milk & mix together until thick. (add more milk if needed slowly)
Roll the mixture with your hands into 9 smaller balls (30g each ball)
Place each ball onto a board, big plate or large surface that can fit in the freezer.
Melt & drizzle 1 serving of no added sugar dark chocolate & a dash of oat flour across the balls. (toppings are optional & customisable)
Freeze for 1-2 hours & enjoy! (store in fridge or freezer)

recipes.title: Chocolate Protein Cake
ingredients: 1 Serving Chocolate Protein Powder (Rule 1 Chocolate Fudge)
directions: In a bowl add all the dry ingredients. 30g of oat flour (blended oats), 12g of cocoa powder, 20g of natural sweetener (stevia), 2g of baking powder & a dash of salt.
Mix together the dry ingredients.
Now add the wet ingredients to the bowl. 63g of egg whites, 60ml of unsweetened almond milk, 5ml of olive oil & a drop of salted caramel flavour drops (optional)
Mix everything together until there is no clumps.
Pour the mixture into a on stick baking dish (baking paper is optional) or if using a normal dish spray with non stick spray beforehand.
Bake in the oven at 200 degrees celcius for 20 minutes.
To make the protein icing, in a bowl mix together 100g of vanilla protein yoghurt (YoPro) & 1/2 serving of chocolate protein powder.
Let the cake cool then spread the protein icing on top, add 15g of sprinkles & enjoy! (can be stored in fridge)

recipes.title: Pancakes
ingredients: 130g Egg Whites (or 3 regular eggs but macros will vary)
1 Serving Vanilla Protein Powder (or flavour of choice)
1/2 Serving Chocolate Protein Powder (or flavour of choice)
15ml Unsweetened Almond Milk (water can be substituted or milk of choice) Toppings:
directions: In a blender cup add 80g of banana, 5g of baking powder, 130g of egg whites, 1 serving of vanilla protein powder, 1 tsp of cinnamon & 1/2 tsp of vanilla extract then blend for 1 minute.

In a small separate small bowl mix together 1/2 a serving of chocolate protein powder, 15ml of unsweetened almond milk & mix together with a fork to create a sweet protein sauce! (add the almond milk slowly while mixing to get the perfect texture, add more milk if needed)

Now it's time to cook the pancakes! Place a non stick pan on the stove on medium heat & pour the pancake mixture slowly into the pan once hot. You can either create big pancakes or smaller ones like i have in the picture above, the choice is yours!
Cook the pancakes for 1 - 2 minutes on each side & once all the pancakes are done it's time to add the toppings.
Add 1 Tbsp of light whipped cream & 15g of blueberries on top then finish off by drizzling the protein sauce all over the pancakes (protein sauce from step 2) & enjoy!

recipes.title: Untitled Recipe
directions: Add 200g of vanilla protein yoghurt to a bowl. (or any flavour of choice)
Add 50g of Milo protein cereal, 80g of blueberries & that's it! Enjoy!

recipes.title: Chocolate Crepes
ingredients: 10g Vanilla Protein Powder (or flavour of choice)
80ml Unsweetened Almond Milk (or milk of choice)
100g YoPro Vanilla Protein Yoghurt (or yoghurt of choice)
10g Chocolate Protein Powder (or flavour of choice)
1/2 Tsp Cinnamon (Optional) 1 Tbsp No Added Sugar Chocolate Sauce (Brand: Natvia) Topping:
directions: Start by blending 50g of oats in a blender. (this will create oat flour)
Once blended add 10g of vanilla protein powder, 80ml of unsweetened almond milk, 80ml of water, 1 egg & blend again for 1 minute.

Now it's time to cook the crepes! Using a non stick pan with the stove on medium heat pour the crepe mixture in slowly & fill the pan all the way to the edges, make sure the crepe mixture layer is thin & not too thick like pancakes. (3 crepes in total)
Cook for 3 - 5 minutes on each side, as these are crepes they will cook much faster compared to pancakes since they are thinner.
In a small bowl mix together 100g of vanilla protein yoghurt & 10g of chocolate protein powder, mix well with a fork to create a protein filling sauce.
Fold each crepe in half & spread 35g of the chocolate protein filling sauce across each crepe.
Fold over each crepe again so that the protein chocolate filling sauce is in the middle.
For the toppings sprinkle 1/2 tsp of cinnamon & 1 Tbsp of no added sugar chocolate sauce across all 3 crepes & enjoy! (toppings are optional & customisable to your liking)

recipes.title: Workout Snack Idea
ingredients: 1 Low Calorie Wrap/Tortilla (i used Mission's Low Gi Protein Wrap)
2 Tbsp Sugar Free Maple Syrup (Optional) 1 Tsp Brown Sugar Stevia or Cinnamon
directions: In a small bowl mix together 1 serving (13g) of powdered peanut butter & 2 Tbsp of sugar free maple syrup. (slowly add the sugar free maple syrup while mixing until you have the perfect peanut butter like texture)
Spread the powdered peanut butter mixture evenly across the wrap/tortilla.
Place 1 banana on top of the wrap/tortilla at the edge closest to you so that you are able to roll it.
Sprinkle 1 tsp of brown sugar stevia or cinnamon on top. (optional)
Roll the wrap/tortilla & cut into slices like shown in the picture above.
Cook on a non stick pan with the stove on low heat for 1 minute on each side of the slices & enjoy!

recipes.title: Low Calorie Kit Kat Protein Shake
ingredients: 1 Serving Chocolate Protein Powder (Brand: Rule1 Chocolate Fudge)
5g PB2 Peanut Butter With Cocoa Powder (or regular powdered peanut butter/cocoa powder)
60g Low Fat Greek Yoghurt (Brand: YoPro Vanilla - regular or flavoured works)
1/2 Tsp Xanthan Gum (optional but makes it thicker)
1 Serving Sugar Free Chocolate Sauce (Brand: Callowfit)
directions: In a blender cup add 120ml unsweetened almond milk, 1 serving of chocolate protein powder, 5g of PB2 with cocoa, 1 serving of kit kat, 60g of low fat greek yoghurt, 1/2 tsp of xanthan gum & 1 cup of ice.
Blend everything together for around 2 minutes with 30 second intervals (add more milk or ice if needed)
Pour the protein shake into a cup & add 1 Tbsp of light whipped cream, 1 serving of sugar free chocolate sauce & 1/2 serving of crushed kit kat, Enjoy!

recipes.title: Untitled Recipe
ingredients: 1.5 Servings Protein Powder (any flavour, i used Cinnamon Churros by Muscle Nation)
directions: In a blender cup add 150g of egg whites, 1.5 servings of protein powder, 2 tsp of stevia, 1/2 tsp of baking powder & blend everything together.
Turn the stove on high heat & place the pancake mixture into a non stick pan.
Cook for around 6 - 7 minutes on each side.
Add 30g of sugar free chocolate sauce & 1 tsp of cinnamon over the pancake & enjoy! (toppings are optional & customisable to your liking)

recipes.title: Low Calorie Berry Crumble
ingredients: 20g Brown Sugar Stevia (or any artificial sweetener, i used the brand Natvia)
40g Crushed Sugar Free Digestive Biscuits (or any digestive biscuit, i used the brand Gullón from woolworths)
directions: In a small microwaveable bowl add 400g of mixed berries & microwave for 2 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 200 degrees celsius.
Once the berries are microwaved add 20g of brown sugar stevia, 2 Tbsp of sugar free maple syrup & mix gently with a spoon to combine.
Pour the berries into a oven safe baking dish & sprinkle 50g of oats, 40g of crushed digestive biscuits & 1 Tbsp of cinnamon on top.
Bake in the oven at 180 degrees celsius for 20 - 30 minutes or until the top is golden brown & crunchy.
Serve with your favourite ice cream or toppings & enjoy! (store in fridge)

recipes.title: Protein Rice Crispy Bars
ingredients: 100g YoPro Vanilla Protein Yoghurt (can be substituted for greek yoghurt)
1 Serving Vanilla Protein Powder (or flavour of choice)
1 Serving (13g) Melted No Added Sugar Milk Chocolate Topping: (Optional)
directions: In a bowl add 100g of rice puffs, 100g of vanilla protein yoghurt, 1 Tbsp of sugar free maple syrup & 1 serving of vanilla protein powder.
Mix together with a large spoon/wooden spatula then add to a baking dish/tray with baking paper underneath.
Press down on the rice puff mixture firmly & flatten the top so that everything is compact.
Freeze for 1 - 2 hours.
After 1 - 2 hours take it out the freezer & drizzle 1 serving of melted no added sugar milk chocolate across the rice puff mixture. (topping is optional)
Cut into 4 even bars & enjoy! (store in freezer)

recipes.title: Strawberry Cheesecake Oats
ingredients: 25g Casein Custard (i used white chocolate casein custard by Muscle Nation but it can be substituted for any flavour or regular protein powder)
50ml Unsweetened Almond Milk (or milk of choice)
100g YoPro Vanilla Protein Yoghurt (or yoghurt of choice)
20g Low Sugar Fruit Spread (i used the Natvia 95% less sugar strawberry fruit spread)
directions: In a bowl/container add 30g of oats, 25g of casein custard & 50ml of unsweetened almond milk then mix together with a spoon.
Smooth over the oats with the bottom of a spoon to flatten the top nice & evenly.
In a separate bowl add 100g of vanilla protein yoghurt, 20g of strawberry fruit spread & mix together.
Spread the yoghurt & strawberry mixture evenly on top of the oats.
Add 20g of chopped strawberries on top & refrigerate for 1 - 2 hours. After about 1 - 2 hours the mixture should be firm, enjoy! (store in fridge)

recipes.title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Protein Shake
ingredients: 1 Serving Caramel Powder (Brand: Rule1 Salted Caramel - vanilla or chocolate will work too)
13g PB2 Peanut Butter With Cocoa Powder (or regular powdered peanut butter/cocoa powder)
1 Tbsp Sugar Free Maple Syrup (Brand: Steeves)
1/2 Tsp Xanthan Gum (optional, makes it thicker but you can use more ice instead)
1 Serving Sugar Free Chocolate Sauce (Brand: Callowfit)
1.5 Tbsp Light Whipped Cream (Brand: Woolworths) Topping: (optional)
directions: In a blender cup add 120ml of unsweetened almond milk, 1 serving of caramel protein powder, 13g of PB2 peanut butter with cocoa, 1 Tbsp of sugar free maple syrup, 1/2 tsp of xanthan gum & 1 cup of ice.
Blend everything together for around 2 minutes with 30 second intervals.
In a small bowl add 10g of PB2 peanut butter with cocoa & slowly add water while mixing to create the sauce.

Drizzle 1 serving of sugar free chocolate sauce around a cup then pour the shake inside & top it off with 1.5 Tbsp of light whipped cream, the PB2 sauce from step 3 & 10g of crushed chocolate covered peanuts & enjoy!

recipes.title: Low Calorie Mini Apple Crumble
ingredients: 1 Arnott's Biscuit (any brand biscuits will work)
directions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees celsius.
Slice an apple into small cubes & remove the core.
Place the cubed apple pieces into a bowl then add 1 Tbsp of natural sweetener (stevia), 1 tsp of cinnamon & 1 Tbsp of sugar free maple syrup.
Mix everything together so that all of the apple pieces are covered completely.
Pour the apple pieces into a small oven safe baking dish.
Crush 1 Arnott's biscuit (or any biscuit) & sprinkle it on top of the apples pieces.
Sprinkle 2g of oats on top for extra crunch (optional)
Bake in the oven at 180 degrees celsius for 30 minutes & enjoy!

recipes.title: Blueberry Sorbet
directions: Weigh 250g of frozen blueberries & add them to a blender cup.
Pour 200ml of water into the blender cup.

Add 20g of natural sweetener (stevia) to the blender cup. (the brand ''Natvia'' has a natural sweetener that only has 0.4 calories per serving, if you would like the sorbet even sweeter you can use more or less all depending on your liking)
Add 2-3 cups of ice to the blender cup. (for bigger ice cubes use 2 cups of ice)
Blend for 1-2 minutes & enjoy! This makes up to 1 Litre! Perfect for a hot summer day.
